Catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ katamā vipattīti? Sīlavipatti. Sattannaṃ āpattikkhandhānaṃ katamo āpattikkhandhoti? Saṅghādisesāpattikkhandho. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ katihi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhātīti? Dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – siyā kāyato ca vācato ca samuṭṭhāti, na cittato; siyā kāyato ca vācato [P 5.0056] ca cittato ca samuṭṭhāti…pe… kenābhatanti? Paramparābhataṃ –

207. That Saṅghādisesa training rule which was laid down by the Blessed One—the one who knows, the one who sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One—for a bhikkhunī who disputes contentiously and creates a legal issue: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā lived as one who disputes contentiously; in that matter. Is there an original formulation, a subsequent formulation, an unenacted formulation? There is one original formulation. There is no subsequent formulation or unenacted formulation in this case. Is it a universal formulation or a local formulation? It is a universal formulation. Is it a common formulation or an uncommon formulation? It is an uncommon formulation. Is it a one-sided formulation or a two-sided formulation? It is a one-sided formulation. Among the four recitations of the Pātimokkha, where is it included, where is it comprised? It is included in the Introduction, comprised in the Introduction. By which recitation does it come up for recitation? It comes up for recitation with the third recitation. Among the four kinds of failure, which failure is it? It is a failure in virtue. Among the seven classes of offenses, which class of offense is it? It is the class of Saṅghādisesa offenses. Among the six origins of offenses, by how many origins does it arise? It arises from two origins: sometimes it arises from body and speech, but not from mind; sometimes it arises from body, speech, and mind. ... By whom was it brought? It was brought by the succession of teachers—

Upāli dāsako ceva, soṇako siggavo tathā;

Moggaliputtena pañcamā, ete jambusirivhaye. …pe…;

Upāli and Dāsaka, Soṇaka and Siggava likewise, with Moggaliputta as the fifth; these recited the Vinaya in the Rose-Apple Isle (Jambudīpa). ...

Ete nāgā mahāpaññā, vinayaññū maggakovidā;

Vinayaṃ dīpe pakāsesuṃ, piṭakaṃ tambapaṇṇiyāti.

These noble ones, of great wisdom, knowers of the Vinaya, skilled in the path, proclaimed the Vinaya Piṭaka on the island of Tambapaṇṇi.

208. Coriṃ [V 0.0112] vuṭṭhāpentiyā saṅghādiseso kattha paññattoti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññatto. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī coriṃ vuṭṭhāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – siyā vācato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhāti, na kāyato; siyā kāyato ca vācato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhāti…pe….

208. For a bhikkhunī who gives ordination to a female thief: where was the Saṅghādisesa training rule laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā gave ordination to a female thief; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Among the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: sometimes it arises from speech and mind, but not from body; sometimes it arises from body, speech, and mind. ...

209. Ekāya gāmantaraṃ gacchantiyā saṅghādiseso kattha paññattoti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññatto. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī ekā gāmantaraṃ gacchi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti, tisso anupaññattiyo. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti [T 0.0142] – paṭhamapārājike…pe….

209. For a bhikkhunī who goes to another village alone: where was the Saṅghādisesa training rule laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In what matter? A certain bhikkhunī went to another village alone; in that matter. There is one original formulation and three subsequent formulations. Among the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin, as in the case of the first Pārājika offense. ...

210. Samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṅghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ [M 0.0101] osārentiyā saṅghādiseso kattha paññattoti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññatto. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī samaggena saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena anapaloketvā kārakasaṅghaṃ anaññāya gaṇassa chandaṃ osāresi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

210. For a bhikkhunī who, without having informed the Saṅgha that performed the act and without having ascertained the consent of the group, reinstates a bhikkhunī suspended by a unified Saṅgha in accordance with the Dhamma, the Vinaya, and the Teacher’s instruction: where was the Saṅghādisesa training rule laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā, without having informed the Saṅgha that performed the act and without having ascertained the consent of the group, reinstated a bhikkhunī suspended by a unified Saṅgha in accordance with the Dhamma, the Vinaya, and the Teacher’s instruction; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Among the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin: the laying down of the burden... etc.

211. Avassutāya bhikkhuniyā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthato khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā bhuñjantiyā saṅghādiseso kattha paññattoti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññatto. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sundarīnandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sundarīnandā bhikkhunī avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthato āmisaṃ paṭiggahesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – paṭhamapārājike…pe….

211. For an impassioned bhikkhunī who, having received with her own hand either edible or staple food from the hand of an impassioned man, eats it: where was the Saṅghādisesa training rule laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Sundarīnandā. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Sundarīnandā, being impassioned, received food from the hand of an impassioned man; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Among the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin: that of the first Pārājika... etc.

212. “Kiṃ te, ayye, eso purisapuggalo karissati avassuto vā anavassuto vā, yato tvaṃ anavassutā! Iṅgha, ayye, yaṃ te eso purisapuggalo deti khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā, taṃ tvaṃ [T 0.0143] sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khāda vā bhuñja vā”ti uyyojentiyā saṅghādiseso kattha paññattoti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññatto. Kaṃ arabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā [V 0.0113] bhikkhunī –“kiṃ te, ayye, eso purisapuggalo karissati avassuto vā anavassuto vā, yato tvaṃ anavassutā! Iṅgha, ayye, yaṃ te eso purisapuggalo deti khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā, taṃ tvaṃ sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khāda vā bhuñja vā”ti uyyojesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

212. For a bhikkhunī who encourages another, saying, ‘Venerable lady, what can this man do to you, whether he is impassioned or not impassioned, since you are not impassioned? Come now, venerable lady, whatever edible or staple food this man gives you, receive it with your own hand and eat it’: where was the Saṅghādisesa training rule laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In what matter? A certain bhikkhunī encouraged another, saying, ‘Venerable lady, what can this man do to you, whether he is impassioned or not impassioned, since you are not impassioned? Come now, venerable lady, whatever edible or staple food this man gives you, receive it with your own hand and eat it’; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Among the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... etc.

213. Kupitāya anattamanāya bhikkhuniyā yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjantiyā [P 5.0057] saṅghādiseso kattha paññattoti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññatto. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Caṇḍakāḷiṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī kupitā anattamanā evaṃ avaca – “buddhaṃ paccācikkhāmi, dhammaṃ paccācikkhāmi, saṅghaṃ paccācikkhāmi, sikkhaṃ paccācikkhāmī”ti, tasmiṃ [M 0.0102] vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

213. For a bhikkhunī who, being angry and displeased, does not desist after being admonished up to the third time: where was the Saṅghādisesa training rule laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Caṇḍakāḷī. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Caṇḍakāḷī, being angry and displeased, spoke thus: “I renounce the Buddha, I renounce the Dhamma, I renounce the Saṅgha, I renounce the training”; in that matter. There is one original formulation. It arises from one origin among the six origins of offenses: by the laying down of the burden... etc.

214. Kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatāya bhikkhuniyā yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjantiyā saṅghādiseso kattha paññattoti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññatto. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Caṇḍakāḷiṃ [T 0.0144] bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī kismiñcideva adhikaraṇe paccākatā kupitā anattamanā evaṃ avaca – “chandagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo, dosagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo, mohagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo, bhayagāminiyo ca bhikkhuniyo”ti, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

214. For a bhikkhunī who, having been defeated in some legal issue whatsoever, does not desist after being admonished up to the third time: where was the Saṅghādisesa training rule laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Caṇḍakāḷī. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Caṇḍakāḷī, having been defeated in some legal issue whatsoever, was angry and displeased and spoke thus: “The bhikkhunīs go astray through favoritism, the bhikkhunīs go astray through hatred, the bhikkhunīs go astray through delusion, and the bhikkhunīs go astray through fear”; in that matter. There is one original formulation. It arises from one origin among the six origins of offenses: by the laying down of the burden... etc.

215. Saṃsaṭṭhānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjantīnaṃ saṅghādiseso kattha paññattoti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññatto. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo saṃsaṭṭhā vihariṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

215. For bhikkhunīs who, associating with laypeople, do not desist from that conduct after being admonished up to the third time: where was the Saṅghādisesa training rule laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what matter? Many bhikkhunīs lived associating with laypeople; in that matter. There is one original formulation. It arises from one origin among the six origins of offenses: by the laying down of the burden... etc.

216. “Saṃsaṭṭhāva, ayye, tumhe viharatha. Mā tumhe nānā viharitthā”ti uyyojentiyā yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjantiyā saṅghādiseso kattha paññattoti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññatto. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī – “saṃsaṭṭhāva ayye, tumhe viharatha, mā tumhe nānā viharitthā”ti uyyojesi, tasmiṃ [V 0.0114] vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

216. For a bhikkhunī who encourages others, saying, ‘Venerable ladies, you should live only in association with laypeople. Do not live separately,’ and who does not desist after being admonished up to the third time: where was the Saṅghādisesa training rule laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā encouraged others, saying, ‘Venerable ladies, you should live only in association with laypeople. Do not live separately’; in that matter. There is one original formulation. It arises from one origin among the six origins of offenses: by the laying down of the burden... etc.

Dasa saṅghādisesā niṭṭhitā.

The ten Saṅghādisesa training rules are concluded.

Tassuddānaṃ –

This is the summary verse:

Ussayacori [T 0.0145] gāmantaṃ, ukkhittaṃ khādanena ca;

Kiṃ te kupitā kismiñci, saṃsaṭṭhā ñāyate dasāti.

Contentiousness, a thief, another village, a suspended one, and by eating; ‘What is it to you?’, being angry, ‘in some case,’ and association—these are known as the ten.

3. Nissaggiyakaṇḍaṃ

3. The Nissaggiya Section

217. Yaṃ [M 0.0103] tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena pattasannicayaṃ karontiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo pattasannicayaṃ akaṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – kathinake…pe….

217. That Nissaggiya Pācittiya which was laid down by that Blessed One—who knows, who sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Enlightened One—for a bhikkhunī who accumulates bowls: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunīs of the group-of-six. In what matter? The bhikkhunīs of the group-of-six accumulated bowls; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins... and so on.

Akālacīvaraṃ “kālacīvara”nti adhiṭṭhahitvā bhājāpentiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī [P 5.0058] akālacīvaraṃ “kālacīvara”nti adhiṭṭhahitvā bhājāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

That Nissaggiya Pācittiya for a bhikkhunī who, having determined an out-of-season robe to be 'an in-season robe,' causes it to be distributed: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā, having determined an out-of-season robe to be 'an in-season robe,' caused it to be distributed; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... and so on.

Bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattetvā acchindantiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivattetvā acchindi, tasmiṃ [T 0.0146] vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

That Nissaggiya Pācittiya for a bhikkhunī who, having exchanged a robe with a bhikkhunī, forcibly takes it back: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā, having exchanged a robe with a bhikkhunī, forcibly took it back; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... and so on.

Aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpentiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā [V 0.0115] bhikkhunī aññaṃ viññāpetvā aññaṃ viññāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

That Nissaggiya Pācittiya for a bhikkhunī who, having requested one thing, requests another: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā, having requested one thing, requested another; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Aññaṃ cetāpetvā aññaṃ cetāpentiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī aññaṃ cetāpetvā aññaṃ cetāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

That Nissaggiya Pācittiya for a bhikkhunī who, having caused one thing to be exchanged, causes another to be exchanged: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā, having caused one thing to be exchanged, caused another to be exchanged; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena aññaṃ cetāpentiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ katthaṃ paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti[M 0.0104]? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena aññaṃ cetāpesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi [T 0.0147] samuṭṭhāti…pe….

That Nissaggiya Pācittiya for a bhikkhunī who causes another thing to be exchanged with a requisite belonging to the Saṅgha that was intended for a different purpose and designated for a different item: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what matter? Many bhikkhunīs caused another thing to be exchanged with a requisite belonging to the Saṅgha that was intended for a different purpose and designated for a different item; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpentiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena saṅghikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

That Nissaggiya Pācittiya for a bhikkhunī who causes another thing to be exchanged with a personally requested requisite belonging to the Saṅgha that was intended for a different purpose and designated for a different item: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what matter? Many bhikkhunīs caused another thing to be exchanged with a personally requested requisite belonging to the Saṅgha that was intended for a different purpose and designated for a different item; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpentiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena [V 0.0116] aññuddisikena mahājanikena aññaṃ cetāpesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

That Nissaggiya Pācittiya for a bhikkhunī who causes another thing to be exchanged with a requisite belonging to a group that was intended for a different purpose and designated for a different item: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what matter? Many bhikkhunīs caused another thing to be exchanged with a requisite belonging to a group that was intended for a different purpose and designated for a different item; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpentiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena saññācikena [T 0.0148] aññaṃ cetāpesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

That Nissaggiya Pācittiya for a bhikkhunī who causes another thing to be exchanged with a personally requested requisite belonging to a group that was intended for a different purpose and designated for a different item: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what matter? Many bhikkhunīs caused another thing to be exchanged with a personally requested requisite belonging to a group that was intended for a different purpose and designated for a different item; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpentiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena puggalikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

That Nissaggiya Pācittiya for a bhikkhunī who causes another thing to be exchanged with a personally requested, personal requisite that was intended for a different purpose and designated for a different item: where was it laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā caused another thing to be exchanged with a personally requested, personal requisite that was intended for a different purpose and designated for a different item; in that matter. There is one original formulation. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Atirekacatukkaṃsaparamaṃ [M 0.0105] garupāvuraṇaṃ cetāpentiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī rājānaṃ kambalaṃ viññāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the Nissaggiya Pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who causes a heavy covering to be procured, exceeding the maximum value of four kaṃsas? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In regard to what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā requested a woolen blanket from the king; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Atirekaaḍḍhateyyakaṃsaparamaṃ lahupāvuraṇaṃ cetāpentiyā [P 5.0059] nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī rājānaṃ khomaṃ viññāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti [T 0.0149] …pe….

Where was the Nissaggiya Pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who causes a light covering to be procured, exceeding the maximum value of two and a half kaṃsas? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In regard to what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā requested linen cloth from the king; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Dvādasa nissaggiyā pācittiyā niṭṭhitā.

The twelve Nissaggiya Pācittiya rules are concluded.

Tassuddānaṃ –

Its summary:

Pattaṃ akālaṃ kālañca, parivatte ca viññāpe;

Cetāpetvā aññadatthi, saṅghikañca mahājanikaṃ;

Saññācikā puggalikā, catukkaṃsaḍḍhateyyakāti.

Bowl, unseasonable, and seasonable; and exchange, request; having caused to be procured, for another purpose, and communal, for a large group; by request, personal, four kaṃsas, and two and a half kaṃsas.

4. Pācittiyakaṇḍaṃ

4. The Pācittiya Chapter

1. Lasuṇavaggo

1. The Chapter on Garlic

218. Yaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena lasuṇaṃ khādantiyā pācittiyaṃ [V 0.0117] kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī na mattaṃ jānitvā lasuṇaṃ harāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti eḷakalomake…pe….

218. Where was the Pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who eats garlic laid down by that Blessed One, the knowing, the seeing, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In regard to what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā, not knowing the proper measure, had garlic brought; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins... as in the Eḷakalomaka rule... and so on.

Sambādhe lomaṃ saṃharāpentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo sambādhe lomaṃ saṃharāpesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ catūhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the Pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who has hair removed in a confined place? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunīs of the group of six. In regard to what matter? The bhikkhunīs of the group of six had hair removed in a confined place; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from four origins... and so on.

Talaghātake [M 0.0106] pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Dve bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti[T 0.0150]? Dve bhikkhuniyo talaghātakaṃ akaṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – paṭhamapārājike…pe….

Where was the Pācittiya offense laid down for striking the urinary passage? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning two bhikkhunīs. In regard to what matter? Two bhikkhunīs performed the act of striking the urinary passage; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin... as in the first Pārājika... and so on.

Jatumaṭṭhake pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭhakaṃ ādiyi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – paṭhamapārājike…pe….

Where was the Pācittiya offense laid down concerning a polished lac-stick? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In regard to what matter? A certain bhikkhunī used a polished lac-stick; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin... as in the first Pārājika... and so on.

Atirekadvaṅgulapabbaparamaṃ udakasuddhikaṃ ādiyantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sakkesu paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī atigambhīraṃ udakasuddhikaṃ ādiyi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – paṭhamapārājike…pe….

Where was the Pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who performs a water-purification exceeding two finger-joints in depth? It was laid down among the Sakyans. Concerning whom? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In regard to what matter? A certain bhikkhunī performed an excessively deep water-purification; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin... as in the first Pārājika... and so on.

Bhikkhussa bhuñjantassa pānīyena vā vidhūpanena vā upatiṭṭhantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī bhikkhussa bhuñjantassa pānīyena ca vidhūpanena ca upatiṭṭhi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Where was the Pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who attends upon a bhikkhu with water or a fan while he is eating? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In regard to what matter? A certain bhikkhunī attended upon a bhikkhu with water and a fan while he was eating; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins... as in the Eḷakalomaka rule... and so on.

Āmakadhaññaṃ [T 0.0151][P 5.0060][V 0.0118] viññāpetvā bhuñjantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo āmakadhaññaṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ catūhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the Pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who, having requested raw grain, eats it? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In regard to what matter? Many bhikkhunīs, having requested raw grain, ate it; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from four origins... and so on.

Uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā saṅkāraṃ vā vighāsaṃ vā tirokuṭṭe tirokuḍḍe (sī. syā.) chaḍḍentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī uccāraṃ uccārampi passāvampi saṅkārampi vighāsampi (ka.) tirokuṭṭe chaḍḍesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the Pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who discards feces, urine, refuse, or leftovers over a wall? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In regard to what matter? A certain bhikkhunī discarded feces over a wall; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Uccāraṃ [M 0.0107] vā passāvaṃ vā saṅkāraṃ vā vighāsaṃ vā harite chaḍḍentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo uccārampi passāvampi saṅkārampi vighāsampi harite chaḍḍesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the Pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who discards feces, urine, refuse, or leftovers on green growth? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In regard to what matter? Many bhikkhunīs discarded feces, urine, refuse, and leftovers on green growth; in regard to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Naccaṃ vā gītaṃ vā vāditaṃ vā dassanāya gacchantiyā pācittiyaṃ [T 0.0152] kattha paññattanti? Rājagahe paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo naccampi gītampi vāditampi dassanāya agamaṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Regarding the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who goes to see dancing, singing, or instrumental music: Where was it laid down? It was laid down at Rājagaha. Concerning whom was it laid down? Concerning the Group of Six bhikkhunīs. In what matter was it laid down? The Group of Six bhikkhunīs went to see dancing, singing, and instrumental music; in that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: the one related to goat's wool... etc.

Lasuṇavaggo paṭhamo.

The First Chapter on Garlic is finished.

2. Rattandhakāravaggo

2. The Chapter on the Darkness of Night

219. Rattandhakāre appadīpe purisena saddhiṃ ekenekāya santiṭṭhantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī rattandhakāre appadīpe purisena saddhiṃ ekenekā santiṭṭhi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – theyyasatthake…pe….

219. Regarding the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who stands alone with a man in the darkness of night without a lamp: Where was it laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In what matter was it laid down? A certain bhikkhunī stood alone with a man in the darkness of night without a lamp; in that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: the one related to a companion in theft... etc.

Paṭicchanne [V 0.0119] okāse purisena saddhiṃ ekenekāya santiṭṭhantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī paṭicchanne okāse purisena saddhiṃ ekenekā santiṭṭhi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – theyyasatthake…pe….

Regarding the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who stands alone with a man in a concealed place: Where was it laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In what matter was it laid down? A certain bhikkhunī stood alone with a man in a concealed place; in that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: the one related to a companion in theft... etc.

Ajjhokāse purisena saddhiṃ ekenekāya santiṭṭhantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti[T 0.0153]? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī ajjhokāse purisena saddhiṃ ekenekā santiṭṭhi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – theyyasatthake…pe….

Regarding the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who stands alone with a man in an open space: Where was it laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In what matter was it laid down? A certain bhikkhunī stood alone with a man in an open space; in that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: the one related to a companion in theft... etc.

Rathikā [M 0.0108] vā rathiyāya vā (ka.) byūhe vā siṅghāṭake vā purisena saddhiṃ ekenekāya santiṭṭhantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī rathikāyapi byūhepi siṅghāṭakepi purisena saddhiṃ ekenekā santiṭṭhi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – theyyasatthake…pe….

Regarding the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who stands alone with a man on a main road, on a side street, or at a crossroads: Where was it laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter was it laid down? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā stood alone with a man on a main road, on a side street, and at a crossroads; in that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: the one related to a companion in theft... etc.

Purebhattaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamitvā āsane nisīditvā sāmike anāpucchā pakkamantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ[P 5.0061]. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī purebhattaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamitvā āsane nisīditvā sāmike anāpucchā pakkāmi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – kathinake…pe….

Regarding the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who, having approached families before the meal and sat on a seat, departs without asking permission of the owners: Where was it laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In what matter was it laid down? A certain bhikkhunī, having approached families before the meal and sat on a seat, departed without asking permission of the owners; in that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: the one related to the Kathina... etc.

Pacchābhattaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamitvā sāmike anāpucchā āsane abhinisīdantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ[T 0.0154]. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī pacchābhattaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamitvā sāmike anāpucchā āsane abhinisīdi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – kathinake…pe….

Regarding the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who, having approached families after the meal, sits down on a seat without asking permission of the owners: Where was it laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what matter was it laid down? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā, having approached families after the meal, sat down on a seat without asking permission of the owners; in that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: the one related to the Kathina... etc.

Vikāle kulāni upasaṅkamitvā sāmike anāpucchā seyyaṃ santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā [V 0.0120] abhinisīdantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo vikāle kulāni upasaṅkamitvā sāmike anāpucchā seyyaṃ santharitvā abhinisīdiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – kathinake…pe….

Regarding the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who, having approached families at the wrong time and without asking permission of the owners, sits down after spreading out a resting place or having it spread out: Where was it laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what matter was it laid down? Many bhikkhunīs, having approached families at the wrong time and without asking permission of the owners, sat down after spreading out a resting place; in that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: the one related to the Kathina... etc.

Duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Regarding the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who, through what is wrongly grasped and wrongly retained, causes another to be disparaged: Where was it laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In what matter was it laid down? A certain bhikkhunī, through what was wrongly grasped and wrongly retained, caused another to be disparaged; in that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... etc.

Attānaṃ [M 0.0109] vā paraṃ vā nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ [T 0.0155] ārabbhāti? Caṇḍakāḷiṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī attānampi parampi nirayenapi brahmacariyenapi abhisapi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Regarding the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who curses herself or another with hell or with the holy life: Where was it laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? Concerning the bhikkhunī Caṇḍakāḷī. In what matter was it laid down? The bhikkhunī Caṇḍakāḷī cursed herself and another with hell and with the holy life; in that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... etc.

Attānaṃ vadhitvā vadhitvā rodantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Caṇḍakāḷiṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī attānaṃ vadhitvā vadhitvā rodi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who, having struck herself repeatedly, cries, laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning the bhikkhunī Caṇḍakāḷī. In what case was it laid down? The bhikkhunī Caṇḍakāḷī, having struck herself repeatedly, cried; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin: from the abandonment of responsibility... and so on.

Rattandhakāravaggo dutiyo.

The Second Chapter on the Darkness of Night is concluded.

3. Nahānavaggo

3. The Chapter on Bathing

220. Naggāya nahāyantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo naggā nahāyiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

220. Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī bathing naked laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what case was it laid down? Many bhikkhunīs bathed naked; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: from the matter of goat's wool... and so on.

Pamāṇātikkantaṃ udakasāṭikaṃ kārāpentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ[V 0.0121]. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo appamāṇikāyo udakasāṭikāyo dhāresuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā [T 0.0156] paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who has a bathing cloth made that exceeds the proper size laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning the bhikkhunīs of the Group of Six. In what case was it laid down? The bhikkhunīs of the Group of Six wore bathing cloths of improper size; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Bhikkhuniyā [P 5.0062] cīvaraṃ visibbetvā vā visibbāpetvā vā neva sibbentiyā na sibbāpanāya ussukkaṃ karontiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā cīvaraṃ visibbāpetvā neva sibbesi na sibbāpanāya ussukkaṃ akāsi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who, having unstitched a bhikkhuni's robe or having had one unstitched, neither stitches it herself nor makes an effort to have it stitched, laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what case was it laid down? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā, having had a bhikkhuni's robe unstitched, neither stitched it herself nor made an effort to have it stitched; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin: from the abandonment of responsibility... and so on.

Pañcāhikaṃ [M 0.0110] saṅghāṭicāraṃ atikkāmentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhunīnaṃ hatthe cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā santaruttarena janapadacārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti kathinake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who exceeds the five-day period of separation from her robes laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what case was it laid down? Many bhikkhunīs, having left a robe in the hands of other bhikkhunīs, departed on a journey through the countryside with only their under and upper robes; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: from the kathina... and so on.

Cīvarasaṅkamanīyaṃ dhārentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī aññatarāya bhikkhuniyā cīvaraṃ anāpucchā pārupi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – kathinake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who wears a robe taken without permission laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning a certain bhikkhunī. In what case was it laid down? A certain bhikkhunī wore another bhikkhunī’s robe without asking; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: from the kathina... and so on.

Gaṇassa [T 0.0157] cīvaralābhaṃ antarāyaṃ karontiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī gaṇassa cīvaralābhaṃ antarāyaṃ akāsi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who obstructs a gain of robes for the community laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what case was it laid down? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā obstructed a gain of robes for the community; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... and so on.

Dhammikaṃ cīvaravibhaṅgaṃ paṭibāhantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti. Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ [V 0.0122] cīvaravibhaṅgaṃ paṭibāhi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who prevents a rightful distribution of robes laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what case was it laid down? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā prevented a rightful distribution of robes; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... and so on.

Agārikassa vā paribbājakassa vā paribbājikāya vā samaṇacīvaraṃ dentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī agārikassa samaṇacīvaraṃ adāsi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ chahi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who gives a monastic robe to a householder, a male wanderer, or a female wanderer laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what case was it laid down? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā gave a monastic robe to a householder; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from six origins... and so on.

Dubbalacīvarapaccāsāya cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā [T 0.0158] bhikkhunī dubbalacīvarapaccāsāya cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who lets the robe season pass out of a slight hope for a robe laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what case was it laid down? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā let the robe season pass out of a slight hope for a robe; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... and so on.

Dhammikaṃ [M 0.0111] kathinuddhāraṃ paṭibāhantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha[P 5.0063]. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ kathinuddhāraṃ paṭibāhi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who prevents a rightful revocation of the kathina laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom was it laid down? It was laid down concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what case was it laid down? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā prevented a rightful revocation of the kathina; in that case, it was laid down. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... and so on.

Nahānavaggo tatiyo.

The Third Chapter on Bathing is concluded.

4. Tuvaṭṭavaggo

4. The Chapter on Lying Down Together

221. Dvinnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ ekamañce tuvaṭṭentīnaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo [V 0.0123] dve ekamañce tuvaṭṭesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

221. Where was the pācittiya offense for two bhikkhunīs lying down on one couch laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what case? Many bhikkhunīs, two of them, lay down on one couch; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from two of the six origins of offenses—as in the case of the ram's wool... etc.

Dvinnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ ekattharaṇapāvuraṇe tuvaṭṭentīnaṃ pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo dve ekattharaṇapāvuraṇā tuvaṭṭesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi [T 0.0159] samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for two bhikkhunīs lying down with one spread and one covering laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what case? Many bhikkhunīs, two of them, having one spread and one covering, lay down; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from two of the six origins of offenses—as in the case of the ram's wool... etc.

Bhikkhuniyā sañcicca aphāsuṃ karontiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā sañcicca aphāsuṃ akāsi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for a bhikkhunī who intentionally causes discomfort laid down? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what case? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā intentionally caused discomfort to a bhikkhunī; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from three of the six origins of offenses... etc.

Dukkhitaṃ sahajīviniṃ neva upaṭṭhentiyā na upaṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karontiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī dukkhitaṃ sahajīviniṃ neva upaṭṭhesi na upaṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ akāsi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who neither attends to her afflicted co-resident disciple nor makes an effort to have her attended to? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what case? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā neither attended to her afflicted co-resident disciple nor made an effort to have her attended to; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from one of the six origins of offenses—as in the case of abandoning the responsibility... etc.

Bhikkhuniyā [M 0.0112] upassayaṃ datvā kupitāya anattamanāya nikkaḍḍhantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā upassayaṃ datvā kupitā anattamanā nikkaḍḍhi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who, having given a dwelling to a bhikkhunī, then, being angry and displeased, expels her? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In what case? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā, having given a dwelling to a bhikkhunī, then, being angry and displeased, expelled her; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from three of the six origins of offenses... etc.

Saṃsaṭṭhāya bhikkhuniyā yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjantiyā [T 0.0160] pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Caṇḍakāḷiṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī saṃsaṭṭhā vihari, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who associates with laypeople and who, being admonished up to the third time, does not relinquish it? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Caṇḍakāḷī. In what case? The bhikkhunī Caṇḍakāḷī lived associating with laypeople; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from one of the six origins of offenses—as in the case of abandoning the responsibility... etc.

Antoraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikāya cārikaṃ carantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā [P 5.0064] bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo antoraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikāyo cārikaṃ cariṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who journeys without a companion within a country agreed to be dubious and fraught with danger? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what case? Many bhikkhunīs journeyed without companions within a country agreed to be dubious and fraught with danger; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from two of the six origins of offenses—as in the case of the ram's wool... etc.

Tiroraṭṭhe [V 0.0124] sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikāya cārikaṃ carantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo tiroraṭṭhe sāsaṅkasammate sappaṭibhaye asatthikāyo cārikaṃ cariṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who journeys without a companion outside the country in a region agreed to be dubious and fraught with danger? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what case? Many bhikkhunīs journeyed without companions outside the country in a region agreed to be dubious and fraught with danger; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from two of the six origins of offenses—as in the case of the ram's wool... etc.

Antovassaṃ cārikaṃ carantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Rājagahe [T 0.0161] paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo antovassaṃ cārikaṃ cariṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who journeys during the rains-residence? It was laid down in Rājagaha. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what case? Many bhikkhunīs journeyed during the rains-residence; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from two of the six origins of offenses—as in the case of the ram's wool... etc.

Vassaṃvuṭṭhāya vassaṃvutthāya (sī. syā.) bhikkhuniyā cārikaṃ na pakkamantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Rājagahe paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha[M 0.0113]. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo vassaṃvuṭṭhā cārikaṃ na pakkamiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – paṭhamapārājike…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who, having completed the rains-residence, does not depart on a journey? It was laid down in Rājagaha. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In what case? Many bhikkhunīs, having completed the rains-residence, did not depart on a journey; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from one of the six origins of offenses—as in the case of the first pārājika... etc.

Tuvaṭṭavaggo catuttho.

The Fourth Chapter on Lying Down.

5. Cittāgāravaggo

5. The Chapter on the Picture Gallery.

222. Rājāgāraṃ vā cittāgāraṃ vā ārāmaṃ vā uyyānaṃ vā pokkharaṇiṃ vā dassanāya gacchantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo rājāgārampi cittāgārampi dassanāya agamaṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

222. Where was the pācittiya offense laid down for a bhikkhunī who goes for the purpose of seeing a royal pleasure house, a picture gallery, a park, a garden, or a pond? It was laid down in Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the group-of-six bhikkhunīs. In what case? The group-of-six bhikkhunīs went for the purpose of seeing a royal pleasure house and a picture gallery; in that case. There is one original enactment. It arises from two of the six origins of offenses—as in the case of the ram's wool... etc.

Āsandiṃ vā pallaṅkaṃ vā paribhuñjantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā [T 0.0162] bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo āsandimpi pallaṅkampi paribhuñjiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who uses a high chair or a couch with animal-figured legs? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In reference to what matter? Many bhikkhunīs used a high chair and a couch with animal-figured legs; in reference to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from two origins, as in the Eḷakalomaka rule... etc.

Suttaṃ [V 0.0125] kantantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo suttaṃ kantiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who spins thread? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the group-of-six bhikkhunīs. In reference to what matter? The group-of-six bhikkhunīs spun thread; in reference to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from two origins, as in the Eḷakalomaka rule... etc.

Gihiveyyāvaccaṃ karontiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo gihiveyyāvaccaṃ akaṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who performs services for householders? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In reference to what matter? Many bhikkhunīs performed services for householders; in reference to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from two origins, as in the Eḷakalomaka rule... etc.

Bhikkhuniyā “ehāyye imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamehī”ti vuccamānāya “sādhū”ti paṭissuṇitvā neva vūpasamentiyā na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karontiyā [M 0.0114] pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā [P 5.0065] bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā – “ehāyye, imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamehī”ti vuccamānā “sādhū”ti paṭissuṇitvā neva vūpasamesi [T 0.0163] na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ akāsi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who, when told by another bhikkhunī, “Come, venerable lady, settle this legal issue,” having agreed by saying, “Good,” neither settles it herself nor makes an effort for its settlement? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In reference to what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā, when told by another bhikkhunī, “Come, venerable lady, settle this legal issue,” having agreed by saying, “Good,” neither settled it herself nor made an effort for its settlement; in reference to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from one origin, as in the case of laying down the burden... etc.

Agārikassa vā paribbājakassa vā paribbājikāya vā sahatthā khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā dentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī agārikassa sahatthā khādanīyampi bhojanīyampi adāsi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who gives hard food or soft food with her own hand to a householder, a male wanderer, or a female wanderer? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In reference to what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā gave hard food and soft food with her own hand to a householder; in reference to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from two origins, as in the Eḷakalomaka rule... etc.

Āvasathacīvaraṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī āvasathacīvaraṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñji, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – kathinake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who uses a seasonal robe without having relinquished it? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In reference to what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā used a seasonal robe without having relinquished it; in reference to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from two origins, as in the Kathinake rule... etc.

Āvasathaṃ anissajjitvā cārikaṃ pakkamantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ [V 0.0126] paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī āvasathaṃ anissajjitvā cārikaṃ pakkāmi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti [T 0.0164] – kathinake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who departs on a journey without having relinquished her lodging? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. In reference to what matter? The bhikkhunī Thullanandā departed on a journey without having relinquished her lodging; in reference to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from two origins, as in the Kathinake rule... etc.

Tiracchānavijjaṃ pariyāpuṇantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo tiracchānavijjaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – padasodhamme…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who learns worldly arts? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the group-of-six bhikkhunīs. In reference to what matter? The group-of-six bhikkhunīs learned worldly arts; in reference to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from two origins, as in the Padasodhamma rule... etc.

Tiracchānavijjaṃ vācentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti. Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo [M 0.0115] tiracchānavijjaṃ vācesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – padasodhamme…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who teaches worldly arts? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the group-of-six bhikkhunīs. In reference to what matter? The group-of-six bhikkhunīs taught worldly arts; in reference to that matter. There is one enactment. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from two origins, as in the Padasodhamma rule... etc.

Cittāgāravaggo pañcamo.

The fifth chapter, the Cittāgāravagga, is concluded.

6. Ārāmavaggo

6. The Sixth Chapter: The Ārāmavagga.

223. Jānaṃ sabhikkhukaṃ ārāmaṃ anāpucchā pavisantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārāmaṃ anāpucchā pavisiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti, dve anupaññattiyo. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

223. Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who, knowing a monastery contains a bhikkhu, enters without asking permission? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. In reference to what matter? Many bhikkhunīs entered a monastery without asking permission; in reference to that matter. There is one original enactment and two supplementary enactments. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from one origin, as in the case of laying down the burden... etc.

Bhikkhuṃ akkosantiyā paribhāsantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Vesāliyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo [T 0.0165] ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo āyasmantaṃ upāliṃ akkosiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offence laid down for a bhikkhunī who insults or reviles a bhikkhu? It was laid down at Vesālī. Concerning whom? Concerning the group-of-six bhikkhunīs. In reference to what matter? The group-of-six bhikkhunīs insulted the Venerable Upāli; in reference to that matter. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of an offence, it arises from three origins... etc.

Caṇḍīkatāya gaṇaṃ paribhāsantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ [P 5.0066] paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Thullanandā bhikkhunī caṇḍīkatāya [V 0.0127] gaṇaṃ paribhāsi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who, being cantankerous, reviles a group? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning the bhikkhunī Thullanandā. On what occasion? On the occasion when the bhikkhunī Thullanandā, being cantankerous, reviled a group. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... etc...

Nimantitāya vā pavāritāya vā khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā aññatra bhuñjantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo bhuttāviniyo pavāritā aññatra bhuñjiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ catūhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who, having been invited or having indicated satisfaction, eats hard food or soft food elsewhere? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. On what occasion? On the occasion when many bhikkhunīs, having finished eating and having indicated satisfaction, ate elsewhere. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from four origins... etc...

Kulaṃ maccharāyantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī kulaṃ maccharāyi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who is possessive about a family? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. On what occasion? On the occasion when a certain bhikkhunī was possessive about a family. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... etc...

Abhikkhuke [M 0.0116] āvāse vassaṃ vasantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti[T 0.0166]? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo abhikkhuke āvāse vassaṃ vasiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – eḷakalomake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who spends the rains-residence in a dwelling without bhikkhus? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. On what occasion? On the occasion when many bhikkhunīs spent the rains-residence in a dwelling without bhikkhus. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: as in the case of the sheep's wool... etc...

Vassaṃvuṭṭhāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṅghe tīhi ṭhānehi na pavārentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo vassaṃvuṭṭhā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhikkhunisaṃghe (ka.) na pavāresuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who, having completed the rains-residence, does not perform the pavāraṇā ceremony before both Saṅghas on three grounds? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. On what occasion? On the occasion when many bhikkhunīs, having completed the rains-residence, did not perform the pavāraṇā ceremony with the Bhikkhu Saṅgha. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin: from laying down the burden... etc...

Ovādāya vā saṃvāsāya vā na gacchantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sakkesu paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ovādaṃ na gacchiṃsu, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – paṭhamapārājike…pe….

Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who does not go for admonition or to ask about the Uposatha and Pavāraṇā? It was laid down in the Sakyan country. Concerning whom? Concerning the group-of-six bhikkhunīs. On what occasion? On the occasion when the group-of-six bhikkhunīs did not go for admonition. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin: as in the case of the first pārājika... etc...

Uposathampi na pucchantiyā ovādampi na yācantiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ [V 0.0128] paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo uposathampi na pucchiṃsu ovādampi na yāciṃsu, tasmiṃ [T 0.0167] vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhāti – dhuranikkhepe…pe….

Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who neither asks about the Uposatha nor requests admonition? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. On what occasion? On the occasion when many bhikkhunīs neither asked about the Uposatha nor requested admonition. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from one origin: from laying down the burden... etc...

Pasākhe jātaṃ gaṇḍaṃ vā rudhitaṃ ruhitaṃ (sī. syā.) vā anapaloketvā saṅghaṃ vā gaṇaṃ vā purisena saddhiṃ ekenekāya bhedāpentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Aññataraṃ bhikkhuniṃ ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Aññatarā bhikkhunī pasākhe jātaṃ gaṇḍaṃ purisena saddhiṃ ekenekā bhedāpesi, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ dvīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti – kathinake…pe….

Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who, without having obtained permission from the Saṅgha or a group, has a boil or a bleeding sore that has arisen on the area between the thighs lanced by a man, one on one with him? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning a certain bhikkhunī. On what occasion? On the occasion when a certain bhikkhunī had a boil that had arisen on the area between the thighs lanced by a man, one on one with him. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from two origins: as in the case of the kathina... etc...

Ārāmavaggo chaṭṭho.

The Sixth Chapter on Monasteries.

7. Gabbhinīvaggo

7. The Chapter on Pregnant Women

224. Gabbhiniṃ [M 0.0117] vuṭṭhāpentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ[P 5.0067]. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo gabbhiniṃ vuṭṭhāpesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

224. Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who gives the higher ordination to a pregnant woman? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. On what occasion? On the occasion when many bhikkhunīs gave the higher ordination to a pregnant woman. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... etc...

Pāyantiṃ vuṭṭhāpentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo pāyantiṃ vuṭṭhāpesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who gives the higher ordination to a nursing woman? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. On what occasion? On the occasion when many bhikkhunīs gave the higher ordination to a nursing woman. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... etc...

Dve [T 0.0168] vassāni chasu dhammesu asikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpentiyā pācittiyaṃ [V 0.0129] kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu asikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya training rule laid down concerning a bhikkhunī who gives the higher ordination to a female probationer who has not completed her two-year training in the six rules? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. On what occasion? On the occasion when many bhikkhunīs gave the higher ordination to a female probationer who had not completed her two-year training in the six rules. There is one original enactment. Of the six origins of offenses, it arises from three origins... etc...

Dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ sikkhamānaṃ saṅghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for giving the higher ordination to a female probationer who, having completed her two-year training in the six rules, has not been approved by the Saṅgha laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. On what occasion? On the occasion when many bhikkhunīs gave the higher ordination to a female probationer who, having completed her two-year training in the six rules, has not been approved by the Saṅgha. There is one original enactment. It arises from three of the six origins of offenses... etc.

Ūnadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ vuṭṭhāpentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ūnadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ vuṭṭhāpesuṃ, tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ. Ekā paññatti. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhāti…pe….

Where was the pācittiya offense for giving the higher ordination to a married probationer who is under twelve years of age laid down? It was laid down at Sāvatthī. Concerning whom? Concerning many bhikkhunīs. On what occasion? On the occasion when many bhikkhunīs gave the higher ordination to a married probationer who is under twelve years of age. There is one original enactment. It arises from three of the six origins of offenses... etc.

Paripuṇṇadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ dve vassāni chasu dhammesu asikkhitasikkhaṃ [T 0.0169] vuṭṭhāpentiyā pācittiyaṃ kattha paññattanti? Sāvatthiyaṃ paññattaṃ. Kaṃ ārabbhāti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo ārabbha. Kismiṃ vatthusminti? Sambahulā bhikkhuniyo paripuṇṇadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ dve vassāni chasu dhammesu asikkhitasikkhaṃ vuṭṭhāpesuṃ[M 0.0118], tasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ.
