289. Anuvādādhikaraṇapaccayā kati āpattiyo āpajjati? Anuvādādhikaraṇapaccayā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati. Bhikkhuṃ amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseti, āpatti saṅghādisesassa; amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃseti, āpatti pācittiyassa; amūlikāya ācāravipattiyā anuddhaṃseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa – anuvādādhikaraṇapaccayā imā tisso āpattiyo āpajjati.

289. 289. On account of the condition of a legal issue concerning an accusation, how many offenses does one incur? On account of the condition of a legal issue concerning an accusation, one incurs three offenses. If one accuses a bhikkhu of an unfounded pārājika offense, it is a saṅghādisesa offense; if one accuses him of an unfounded saṅghādisesa offense, it is a pācittiya offense; if one accuses him of an unfounded failure in conduct, it is a dukkaṭa offense. On account of the condition of a legal issue concerning an accusation, one incurs these three offenses.

Tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ kati vipattiyo bhajanti…pe… sattannaṃ samathānaṃ katihi samathehi sammanti? Tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ dve vipattiyo bhajanti – siyā sīlavipattiṃ, siyā ācāravipattiṃ. Sattannaṃ āpattikkhandhānaṃ tīhi āpattikkhandhehi saṅgahitā – siyā saṅghādisesāpattikkhandhena, siyā pācittiyāpattikkhandhena, siyā dukkaṭāpattikkhandhena[T 0.0257][V 0.0203]. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ tīhi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhanti – siyā kāyato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhanti, na vācato; siyā vācato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhanti, na kāyato; siyā kāyato ca vācato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhanti. Catunnaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ, āpattādhikaraṇaṃ. Sattannaṃ samathānaṃ tīhi samathehi sammanti – siyā sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca, siyā sammukhāvinayena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

Of the four failures, how many failures do those offenses fall under? … By how many of the seven settlements are they settled? Those offenses fall under two of the four failures: sometimes failure in virtue, sometimes failure in conduct. They are included in three of the seven aggregates of offenses: sometimes by the aggregate of saṅghādisesa offenses, sometimes by the aggregate of pācittiya offenses, sometimes by the aggregate of dukkaṭa offenses. Of the six origins of offenses, they arise from three origins: sometimes they arise from the body and from the mind, not from speech; sometimes they arise from speech and from the mind, not from the body; sometimes they arise from the body, from speech, and from the mind. Of the four legal issues, it is a legal issue concerning an offense. Of the seven settlements, they are settled by three settlements: sometimes by settlement in the presence and by settlement by acknowledgement, sometimes by settlement in the presence and by covering over with grass.

290. Āpattādhikaraṇapaccayā kati āpattiyo āpajjati? Āpattādhikaraṇapaccayā catasso āpattiyo āpajjati. Bhikkhunī jānaṃ pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicchādeti, āpatti pārājikassa; vematikā paṭicchādeti, āpatti thullaccayassa; bhikkhu saṅghādisesaṃ paṭicchādeti; āpatti pācittiyassa; ācāravipattiṃ paṭicchādeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa – āpattādhikaraṇapaccayā imā catasso āpattiyo āpajjati.

290. On account of the condition of a legal issue concerning an offense, how many offenses does one incur? On account of the condition of a legal issue concerning an offense, one incurs four offenses. If a bhikkhunī knowingly conceals a pārājika offense, it is a pārājika offense; if, being doubtful, she conceals it, it is a thullaccaya offense; if a bhikkhu conceals a saṅghādisesa offense, it is a pācittiya offense; if one conceals a failure in conduct, it is a dukkaṭa offense. On account of the condition of a legal issue concerning an offense, one incurs these four offenses.

Tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ kati vipattiyo bhajanti…pe… sattannaṃ samathānaṃ katihi samathehi sammanti? Tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ dve vipattiyo bhajanti – siyā sīlavipattiṃ, siyā ācāravipattiṃ. Sattannaṃ [M 0.0181] āpattikkhandhānaṃ catūhi āpattikkhandhehi saṅgahitā – siyā pārājikāpattikkhandhena, siyā thullaccayāpattikkhandhena, siyā pācittiyāpattikkhandhena, siyā dukkaṭāpattikkhandhena. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena [T 0.0258] samuṭṭhanti – kāyato ca vācato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhanti. Catunnaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ, āpattādhikaraṇaṃ. Sattannaṃ samathānaṃ tīhi samathehi sammanti – siyā sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca, siyā sammukhāvinayena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

Of the four failures, how many failures do those offenses fall under? … By how many of the seven settlements are they settled? Those offenses fall under two of the four failures: sometimes failure in virtue, sometimes failure in conduct. They are included in four of the seven aggregates of offenses: sometimes by the aggregate of pārājika offenses, sometimes by the aggregate of thullaccaya offenses, sometimes by the aggregate of pācittiya offenses, and sometimes by the aggregate of dukkaṭa offenses. Of the six origins of offenses, they arise from one origin: from the body, from speech, and from the mind. Of the four legal issues, it is a legal issue concerning an offense. Of the seven settlements, they are settled by three settlements: sometimes by settlement in the presence and by settlement by acknowledgement, sometimes by settlement in the presence and by covering over with grass.

291. Kiccādhikaraṇapaccayā kati āpattiyo āpajjati? Kiccādhikaraṇapaccayā pañca āpattiyo āpajjati. Ukkhittānuvattikā bhikkhunī yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjati, ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ; dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā; kammavācāpariyosāne āpatti pārājikassa. Bhedakānuvattakā bhikkhū yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjanti, āpatti saṅghādisesassa; pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsanāya na paṭinissajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa [P 5.0101] – kiccādhikaraṇapaccayā imā pañca āpattiyo āpajjati.

291. On account of the condition of a legal issue concerning duties, how many offenses does one incur? On account of the condition of a legal issue concerning duties, one incurs five offenses. If a bhikkhunī who follows one who has been suspended does not relinquish her view after being admonished up to the third time, there is a dukkaṭa offense with the motion; with the two formal acts, thullaccaya offenses; at the conclusion of the formal act, a pārājika offense. If bhikkhus who follow a schismatic do not relinquish their view after being admonished up to the third time, it is a saṅghādisesa offense. If one does not relinquish a bad view after being admonished up to the third time, it is a pācittiya offense. On account of the condition of a legal issue concerning duties, one incurs these five offenses.

Tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ kati vipattiyo bhajanti…pe… sattannaṃ samathānaṃ katihi [V 0.0204] samathehi sammanti? Tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ dve vipattiyo bhajanti – siyā sīlavipattiṃ, siyā ācāravipattiṃ. Sattannaṃ āpattikkhandhānaṃ pañcahi āpattikkhandhehi saṅgahitā – siyā pārājikāpattikkhandhena, siyā saṅghādisesāpattikkhandhena, siyā thullaccayāpattikkhandhena, siyā pācittiyāpattikkhandhena, siyā dukkaṭāpattikkhandhena. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ ekena samuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhanti – kāyato ca vācato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhanti[T 0.0259]. Catunnaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ, āpattādhikaraṇaṃ. Sattannaṃ samathānaṃ tīhi samathehi sammanti – siyā sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca, siyā sammukhāvinayena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

Those offenses fall under how many of the four kinds of failure... by how many of the seven settlements are they settled? Those offenses fall under two of the four kinds of failure—sometimes failure in virtue, sometimes failure in conduct. They are comprised in five of the seven aggregates of offenses—sometimes by the aggregate of pārājika offenses, sometimes by the aggregate of saṅghādisesa offenses, sometimes by the aggregate of thullaccaya offenses, sometimes by the aggregate of pācittiya offenses, and sometimes by the aggregate of dukkaṭa offenses. Of the six origins of offenses, they arise from one origin: they arise from body, speech, and mind. Of the four legal issues, it is a legal issue concerning offenses. Of the seven settlements, they are settled by three settlements—sometimes by settlement in the presence and by settlement by acknowledgement, or sometimes by settlement in the presence and by settlement by covering over with grass.

Ṭhapetvā satta āpattiyo satta āpattikkhandhe, avasesā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ kati vipattiyo bhajanti? Sattannaṃ āpattikkhandhānaṃ katihi āpattikkhandhehi saṅgahitā? Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ katihi samuṭṭhānehi samuṭṭhanti? Catunnaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ katamaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ? Sattannaṃ samathānaṃ katihi samathehi sammanti? Ṭhapetvā satta āpattiyo satta [M 0.0182] āpattikkhandhe avasesā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ na katamaṃ vipattiṃ bhajanti? Sattannaṃ āpattikkhandhānaṃ na katamena āpattikkhandhena saṅgahitā. Channaṃ āpattisamuṭṭhānānaṃ na katamena āpattisamuṭṭhānena samuṭṭhanti. Catunnaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ na katamaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ. Sattannaṃ samathānaṃ na katamena samathena sammanti. Taṃ kissa hetu? Ṭhapetvā satta āpattiyo satta āpattikkhandhe, natthaññā āpattiyoti.

Setting aside the seven offenses and the seven aggregates of offenses, how many of the four failures do the remaining offenses partake of? By how many of the seven aggregates of offenses are they comprised? From how many of the six origins of offenses do they arise? Which of the four legal issues is it? By how many of the seven settlements are they settled? Setting aside the seven offenses and the seven aggregates of offenses, the remaining offenses do not partake of any of the four failures. They are not comprised in any of the seven aggregates of offenses. They do not arise from any of the six origins of offenses. It is not any of the four legal issues. They are not settled by any of the seven settlements. What is the reason for that? Because, setting aside the seven offenses and the seven aggregates of offenses, there are no other offenses.

Adhikaraṇapaccayavāro niṭṭhito pañcamo.

The fifth Section on Conditions for Legal Issues is concluded.

Antarapeyyālaṃ anantarapeyyālaṃ (sī. syā.) niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Intermediate Repetition Section is concluded.

Tassuddānaṃ –

Its summary:

Katipucchā samuṭṭhānā, katāpatti tatheva ca;

Samuṭṭhānā vipatti ca, tathādhikaraṇena cāti.

The ‘How Many?’ Inquiry and the Origins, and likewise the ‘Offense Committed’; the Origins and the Failures, and likewise with the Legal Issues.

Samathabhedo

The Classification of Settlements

6. Adhikaraṇapariyāyavāro

6. The Section on the Modes of Legal Issues

292. Vivādādhikaraṇassa [T 0.0260][M 0.0183][V 0.0205] – kiṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ? Kati ṭhānāni? Kati vatthūni? Kati bhūmiyo? Kati hetū? Kati mūlāni? Katihākārehi vivadati? Vivādādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati?

292. For a legal issue of dispute: What is its forerunner? How many grounds? How many bases? How many planes? How many causes? How many roots? In how many ways does one dispute? By how many settlements is a legal issue of dispute settled?

Anuvādādhikaraṇassa – kiṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ? Kati ṭhānāni? Kati vatthūni? Kati bhūmiyo? Kati hetū? Kati mūlāni? Katihākārehi anuvadati? Anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati?

For a legal issue of accusation: What is its forerunner? How many grounds? How many bases? How many planes? How many causes? How many roots? In how many ways does one accuse? By how many settlements is a legal issue of accusation settled?

Āpattādhikaraṇassa – kiṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ? Kati ṭhānāni? Kati vatthūni? Kati bhūmiyo? Kati hetū? Kati mūlāni? Katihākārehi āpattiṃ āpajjati? Āpattādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati?

For a legal issue concerning an offense: What is its forerunner? How many grounds? How many bases? How many planes? How many causes? How many roots? In how many ways does one commit an offense? By how many settlements is a legal issue concerning an offense settled?

Kiccādhikaraṇassa – kiṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ? Kati ṭhānāni? Kati vatthūni? Kati bhūmiyo? Kati hetū? Kati mūlāni? Katihākārehi kiccaṃ jāyati? Kiccādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati?

For a legal issue of duties: What is its forerunner? How many grounds? How many bases? How many planes? How many causes? How many roots? In how many ways does a duty arise? By how many settlements is a legal issue of duties settled?

293. Vivādādhikaraṇassa [P 5.0102] kiṃ pubbaṅgamanti? Lobho pubbaṅgamo, doso pubbaṅgamo, moho pubbaṅgamo, alobho pubbaṅgamo, adoso pubbaṅgamo, amoho pubbaṅgamo. Kati ṭhānānīti? Aṭṭhārasa bhedakaravatthūni ṭhānāni. Kati vatthūnīti? Aṭṭhārasa bhedakaravatthūni. Kati bhūmiyoti? Aṭṭhārasa bhedakaravatthūni bhūmiyo. Kati hetūti? Nava hetū – tayo kusalahetū[V 0.0206], tayo akusalahetū, tayo abyākatahetū. Kati mūlānīti? Dvādasa mūlāni. Katihākārehi vivadatīti? Dvīhākārehi vivadati – dhammadiṭṭhi vā adhammadiṭṭhi vā. cūḷava. 228 Vivādādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammatīti? Vivādādhikaraṇaṃ [T 0.0261] dvīhi samathehi sammati – sammukhāvinayena ca yebhuyyasikāya ca.

293. What is the forerunner of a legal issue of dispute? Greed is the forerunner, hatred is the forerunner, delusion is the forerunner; non-greed is the forerunner, non-hatred is the forerunner, non-delusion is the forerunner. How many grounds? The grounds are the eighteen matters causing schism. How many bases? The bases are the eighteen matters causing schism. How many planes? The planes are the eighteen matters causing schism. How many causes? There are nine causes: three wholesome causes, three unwholesome causes, and three indeterminate causes. How many roots? There are twelve roots. In how many ways does one dispute? One disputes in two ways: with the view 'this is Dhamma' or with the view 'this is not Dhamma'. By how many settlements is a legal issue of dispute settled? A legal issue of dispute is settled by two settlements: by the procedure in the presence of and by the procedure of the majority.

294. Anuvādādhikaraṇassa kiṃ pubbaṅgamanti? Lobho pubbaṅgamo, doso pubbaṅgamo, moho pubbaṅgamo, alobho pubbaṅgamo, adoso pubbaṅgamo, amoho pubbaṅgamo. Kati ṭhānānīti? Catasso vipattiyo [M 0.0184] ṭhānāni. Kati vatthūnīti? Catasso vipattiyo vatthūni. Kati bhūmiyoti? Catasso vipattiyo bhūmiyo. Kati hetūti? Nava hetū – tayo kusalahetū, tayo akusalahetū, tayo abyākatahetū. Kati mūlānīti? Cuddasa mūlāni. Katihākārehi anuvadatīti? Dvīhākārehi anuvadati – vatthuto vā āpattito vā. cūḷava. 236 Anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammatīti? Anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ catūhi samathehi sammati – sammukhāvinayena ca sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca.

294. What is the forerunner of a legal issue of accusation? Greed is the forerunner, hatred is the forerunner, delusion is the forerunner; non-greed is the forerunner, non-hatred is the forerunner, non-delusion is the forerunner. How many grounds? The grounds are the four failures. How many bases? The bases are the four failures. How many planes? The planes are the four failures. How many causes? There are nine causes: three wholesome causes, three unwholesome causes, and three indeterminate causes. How many roots? There are fourteen roots. In how many ways does one accuse? One accuses in two ways: by way of the basis or by way of the offense. By how many settlements is a legal issue of accusation settled? A legal issue of accusation is settled by four settlements: by the procedure in the presence of, by the procedure of mindfulness, by the procedure for one who is no longer deranged, and by the procedure for one's further misdeeds.

295. Āpattādhikaraṇassa kiṃ pubbaṅgamanti? Lobho pubbaṅgamo, doso pubbaṅgamo, moho pubbaṅgamo, alobho pubbaṅgamo, adoso pubbaṅgamo, amoho pubbaṅgamo. Kati ṭhānānīti? Satta āpattikkhandhā ṭhānāni. Kati vatthūnīti? Satta āpattikkhandhā vatthūni. Kati bhūmiyoti? Satta āpattikkhandhā bhūmiyo. Kati hetūti? Cha hetū kati hetūti nava hetū, tayo kusalahetū (sī. syā.) – tayo akusalahetū, tayo abyākatahetū. Kati mūlānīti? Cha āpattisamuṭṭhānāni mūlāni[T 0.0262]. Katihākārehi āpattiṃ āpajjatīti? Chahākārehi āpattiṃ āpajjati – alajjitā, aññāṇatā, kukkuccapakatatā, akappiye kappiyasaññitā, kappiye akappiyasaññitā, satisammosā. cūḷava. 239 Āpattādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammatīti? Āpattādhikaraṇaṃ tīhi samathehi sammati – sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca, sammukhāvinayena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

295. What is the forerunner of a legal issue of an offense? Greed is the forerunner, hatred is the forerunner, delusion is the forerunner; non-greed is the forerunner, non-hatred is the forerunner, non-delusion is the forerunner. How many grounds? The seven classes of offenses are the grounds. How many bases? The seven classes of offenses are the bases. How many planes? The seven classes of offenses are the planes. How many causes? There are six causes: three unwholesome causes and three indeterminate causes. How many roots? The six origins of offenses are the roots. In how many ways does one commit an offense? One commits an offense in six ways: through shamelessness, through ignorance, through being overcome by remorse, through perceiving the unallowable as allowable, through perceiving the allowable as unallowable, and through a lapse of mindfulness. By how many settlements is a legal issue of an offense settled? A legal issue of an offense is settled by three settlements: by the procedure in the presence of and acting on an admission, and by the procedure in the presence of and covering over with grass.

296. Kiccādhikaraṇassa kiṃ pubbaṅgamanti? Lobho pubbaṅgamo, doso pubbaṅgamo, moho pubbaṅgamo, alobho pubbaṅgamo, adoso pubbaṅgamo, amoho pubbaṅgamo. Kati ṭhānānīti? Cattāri kammāni ṭhānāni. Kati vatthūnīti? Cattāri kammāni vatthūni. Kati bhūmiyoti? Cattāri kammāni bhūmiyo. Kati hetūti? Nava hetū – tayo kusalahetū, tayo akusalahetū, tayo abyākatahetū. Kati mūlānīti? Ekaṃ mūlaṃ – saṅgho. Katihākārehi kiccaṃ jāyatīti[V 0.0207]? Dvīhākārehi kiccaṃ jāyati – ñattito vā apalokanato vā. cūḷava. 242 Kiccādhikaraṇaṃ [M 0.0185] katihi samathehi sammatīti? Kiccādhikaraṇaṃ ekena samathena sammati – sammukhāvinayena.

296. What is the forerunner of a legal issue of duties? Greed is the forerunner, hatred is the forerunner, delusion is the forerunner; non-greed is the forerunner, non-hatred is the forerunner, non-delusion is the forerunner. How many grounds? The four formal acts are the grounds. How many bases? The four formal acts are the bases. How many planes? The four formal acts are the planes. How many causes? There are nine causes: three wholesome causes, three unwholesome causes, and three indeterminate causes. How many roots? There is one root: the Saṅgha. In how many ways does a duty arise? A duty arises in two ways: by way of a motion or by way of a proclamation. By how many settlements is a legal issue of duties settled? A legal issue of duties is settled by one settlement: by the procedure in the presence of.

Kati [P 5.0103] samathā? Satta samathā. Sammukhāvinayo, sativinayo, amūḷhavinayo, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇavatthārako – ime satta samathā.

How many settlements? Seven settlements: the procedure in the presence of, the procedure of mindfulness, the procedure for past insanity, the procedure of acting on an admission, the procedure of the majority, the procedure for the depraved, and the procedure of covering over with grass. These are the seven settlements.

Siyā ime satta samathā dasa samathā honti, dasa samathā satta samathā honti vatthuvasena pariyāyena siyāti.

Might these seven settlements become ten settlements, and might ten settlements become seven settlements, by way of the basis and by way of the mode? It may be so.

Kathañca siyā? Vivādādhikaraṇassa dve samathā[T 0.0263], anuvādādhikaraṇassa cattāro samathā, āpattādhikaraṇassa tayo samathā, kiccādhikaraṇassa eko samatho. Evaṃ ime satta samathā dasa samathā honti, dasa samathā satta samathā honti vatthuvasena pariyāyena.

And how might it be? For a legal issue of dispute there are two settlements; for a legal issue of accusation, four settlements; for a legal issue of an offense, three settlements; for a legal issue of duties, one settlement. Thus, by way of the basis and by way of the mode, these seven settlements become ten settlements, and ten settlements become seven settlements.

Pariyāyavāro niṭṭhito chaṭṭho.

The Sixth Section on Modes is concluded.

7. Sādhāraṇavāro

7. The Section on Commonality

297. Kati samathā vivādādhikaraṇassa sādhāraṇā? Kati samathā vivādādhikaraṇassa asādhāraṇā? Kati samathā anuvādādhikaraṇassa sādhāraṇā? Kati samathā anuvādādhikaraṇassa asādhāraṇā? Kati samathā āpattādhikaraṇassa sādhāraṇā? Kati samathā āpattādhikaraṇassa asādhāraṇā? Kati samathā kiccādhikaraṇassa sādhāraṇā? Kati samathā kiccādhikaraṇassa asādhāraṇā?

297. How many settlements are common to a legal issue of dispute? How many settlements are not common to a legal issue of dispute? How many settlements are common to a legal issue of accusation? How many settlements are not common to a legal issue of accusation? How many settlements are common to a legal issue of an offense? How many settlements are not common to a legal issue of an offense? How many settlements are common to a legal issue of duties? How many settlements are not common to a legal issue of duties?

Dve samathā vivādādhikaraṇassa sādhāraṇā – sammukhāvinayo, yebhuyyasikā. Pañca samathā vivādādhikaraṇassa asādhāraṇā – sativinayo, amūḷhavinayo, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇavatthārako.

Two settlements are common to a legal issue of dispute: the procedure in the presence of and the procedure of the majority. Five settlements are not common to a legal issue of dispute: the procedure of mindfulness, the procedure for past insanity, the procedure of acting on an admission, the procedure for the depraved, and the procedure of covering over with grass.

Cattāro samathā anuvādādhikaraṇassa sādhāraṇā – sammukhāvinayo; sativinayo, amūḷhavinayo, tassapāpiyasikā. Tayo samathā anuvādādhikaraṇassa asādhāraṇā – yebhuyyasikā, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, tiṇavatthārako.

Four settlements are common to a legal issue of accusation: the procedure in the presence of, the procedure of mindfulness, the procedure for past insanity, and the procedure for the depraved. Three settlements are not common to a legal issue of accusation: the procedure of the majority, the procedure of acting on an admission, and the procedure of covering over with grass.

Tayo [M 0.0186][V 0.0208] samathā āpattādhikaraṇassa sādhāraṇā – sammukhāvinayo, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, tiṇavatthārako. Cattāro samathā āpattādhikaraṇassa asādhāraṇā – yebhuyyasikā, sativinayo, amūḷhavinayo, tassapāpiyasikā[T 0.0264].

Three settlements are common to a legal issue of an offense: the procedure in the presence of, the procedure of acting on an admission, and the procedure of covering over with grass. Four settlements are not common to a legal issue of an offense: the procedure of the majority, the procedure of mindfulness, the procedure for past insanity, and the procedure for the depraved.

Eko samatho kiccādhikaraṇassa sādhāraṇo – sammukhāvinayo. Cha samathā kiccādhikaraṇassa asādhāraṇā – yebhuyyasikā, sativinayo, amūḷhavinayo, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇavatthārako.

One settlement is common to a legal issue of duties: the procedure in the presence of. Six settlements are not common to a legal issue of duties: the procedure of the majority, the procedure of mindfulness, the procedure for past insanity, the procedure of acting on an admission, the procedure for the depraved, and the procedure of covering over with grass.

Sādhāraṇavāro niṭṭhito sattamo.

The Seventh Section on Commonality is concluded.

8. Tabbhāgiyavāro

8. The Section on Correspondence

298. Kati samathā vivādādhikaraṇassa tabbhāgiyā? Kati samathā vivādādhikaraṇassa aññabhāgiyā? Kati samathā anuvādādhikaraṇassa tabbhāgiyā? Kati samathā anuvādādhikaraṇassa aññabhāgiyā? Kati samathā āpattādhikaraṇassa tabbhāgiyā? Kati samathā āpattādhikaraṇassa aññabhāgiyā? Kati samathā kiccādhikaraṇassa tabbhāgiyā? Kati samathā kiccādhikaraṇassa aññabhāgiyā?

298. How many settlements correspond to a legal issue of dispute? How many settlements correspond to other legal issues? How many settlements correspond to a legal issue of accusation? How many settlements correspond to other legal issues? How many settlements correspond to a legal issue of an offense? How many settlements correspond to other legal issues? How many settlements correspond to a legal issue of duties? How many settlements correspond to other legal issues?

Dve [P 5.0104] samathā vivādādhikaraṇassa tabbhāgiyā – sammukhāvinayo, yebhuyyasikā. Pañca samathā vivādādhikaraṇassa aññabhāgiyā – sativinayo, amūḷhavinayo, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇavatthārako.

Two settlements correspond to a legal issue of dispute: the procedure in the presence of and the procedure of the majority. Five settlements correspond to other legal issues: the procedure of mindfulness, the procedure for past insanity, the procedure of acting on an admission, the procedure for the depraved, and the procedure of covering over with grass.

Cattāro samathā anuvādādhikaraṇassa tabbhāgiyā – sammukhāvinayo, sativinayo, amūḷhavinayo, tassapāpiyasikā. Tayo samathā anuvādādhikaraṇassa aññabhāgiyā – yebhuyyasikā, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, tiṇavatthārako.

Four settlements correspond to a legal issue of accusation: the procedure in the presence of, the procedure of mindfulness, the procedure for past insanity, and the procedure for the depraved. Three settlements correspond to other legal issues: the procedure of the majority, the procedure of acting on an admission, and the procedure of covering over with grass.

Tayo samathā āpattādhikaraṇassa tabbhāgiyā – sammukhāvinayo, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, tiṇavatthārako. Cattāro samathā āpattādhikaraṇassa aññabhāgiyā – yebhuyyasikā, sativinayo, amūḷhavinayo, tassapāpiyasikā.

Three settlements correspond to a legal issue of an offense: the procedure in the presence of, the procedure of acting on an admission, and the procedure of covering over with grass. Four settlements correspond to other legal issues: the procedure of the majority, the procedure of mindfulness, the procedure for past insanity, and the procedure for the depraved.

Eko [T 0.0265][M 0.0187][V 0.0209] samatho kiccādhikaraṇassa tabbhāgiyo – sammukhāvinayo. Cha samathā kiccādhikaraṇassa aññabhāgiyā – yebhuyyasikā, sativinayo, amūḷhavinayo, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇavatthārako.

One settlement, the settlement in the presence, is of the same kind as a legal issue concerning duties. Six settlements are of a different kind from a legal issue concerning duties: the settlement by majority, the settlement by mindfulness, the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, the settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, and the settlement of covering with grass.

Tabbhāgiyavāro niṭṭhito aṭṭhamo.

The eighth section, on belonging to the same group, is concluded.

9. Samathā samathassa sādhāraṇavāro

9. 9. The Section on Settlements Being Common to a Settlement

299. Samathā samathassa sādhāraṇā, samathā samathassa asādhāraṇā. Siyā samathā samathassa sādhāraṇā, siyā samathā samathassa asādhāraṇā.

299. Are settlements common to a settlement? Are settlements not common to a settlement? Some settlements are common to a settlement; some settlements are not common to a settlement.

Kathaṃ siyā samathā samathassa sādhāraṇā? Kathaṃ siyā samathā samathassa asādhāraṇā? Yebhuyyasikā sammukhāvinayassa sādhāraṇā, sativinayassa amūḷhavinayassa paṭiññātakaraṇassa tassapāpiyasikāya tiṇavatthārakassa asādhāraṇā.

How are some settlements common to a settlement? How are some settlements not common to a settlement? The settlement by majority is common to the settlement in the presence, but it is not common to the settlement by mindfulness, the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, the settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, or the settlement of covering with grass.

Sativinayo sammukhāvinayassa sādhāraṇo, amūḷhavinayassa paṭiññātakaraṇassa tassapāpiyasikāya tiṇavatthārakassa yebhuyyasikāya asādhāraṇo.

The settlement by mindfulness is common to the settlement in the presence, but it is not common to the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, the settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, the settlement of covering with grass, or the settlement by majority.

Amūḷhavinayo sammukhāvinayassa sādhāraṇo, paṭiññātakaraṇassa tassapāpiyasikāya tiṇavatthārakassa yebhuyyasikāya sativinayassa asādhāraṇo.

The settlement for one who has recovered from insanity is common to the settlement in the presence, but it is not common to the settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, the settlement of covering with grass, the settlement by majority, or the settlement by mindfulness.

Paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ sammukhāvinayassa sādhāraṇaṃ, tassapāpiyasikāya tiṇavatthārakassa yebhuyyasikāya sativinayassa amūḷhavinayassa asādhāraṇaṃ.

The settlement by acknowledgment is common to the settlement in the presence, but it is not common to the settlement for a specific depravity, the settlement of covering with grass, the settlement by majority, the settlement by mindfulness, or the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity.

Tassapāpiyasikā sammukhāvinayassa sādhāraṇā, tiṇavatthārakassa yebhuyyasikāya sativinayassa amūḷhavinayassa paṭiññātakaraṇassa asādhāraṇā.

The settlement for a specific depravity is common to the settlement in the presence, but it is not common to the settlement of covering with grass, the settlement by majority, the settlement by mindfulness, the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, or the settlement by acknowledgment.

Tiṇavatthārako sammukhāvinayassa sādhāraṇo, yebhuyyasikāya sativinayassa amūḷhavinayassa [V 0.0210] paṭiññātakaraṇassa tassapāpiyasikāya asādhāraṇo[M 0.0188]. Evaṃ [T 0.0266] siyā samathā samathassa sādhāraṇā; evaṃ siyā samathā samathassa asādhāraṇā.

The settlement of covering with grass is common to the settlement in the presence, but it is not common to the settlement by majority, the settlement by mindfulness, the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, the settlement by acknowledgment, or the settlement for a specific depravity. Thus, some settlements are common to a settlement; thus, some settlements are not common to a settlement.

Samathā samathassa sādhāraṇavāro niṭṭhito navamo.

The ninth section, on Settlements Being Common to a Settlement, is concluded.

10. Samathā samathassa tabbhāgiyavāro

10. 10. The Section on Settlements Belonging to the Same Group as a Settlement

300. Samathā samathassa tabbhāgiyā, samathā samathassa aññabhāgiyā. Siyā samathā samathassa tabbhāgiyā, siyā samathā samathassa aññabhāgiyā.

300. Do settlements belong to the same group as a settlement, or do they belong to a different group? Some settlements belong to the same group as a settlement; some settlements belong to a different group from a settlement.

Kathaṃ siyā samathā samathassa tabbhāgiyā? Kathaṃ siyā samathā samathassa aññabhāgiyā? Yebhuyyasikā sammukhāvinayassa tabbhāgiyā, sativinayassa amūḷhavinayassa paṭiññātakaraṇassa tassapāpiyasikāya tiṇavatthārakassa aññabhāgiyā.

How is it that some settlements belong to the same group as a settlement? How is it that some settlements belong to a different group from a settlement? The settlement by majority belongs to the same group as the settlement in the presence; it belongs to a different group from the settlement by mindfulness, the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, the settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, and the settlement of covering with grass.

Sativinayo sammukhāvinayassa tabbhāgiyo, amūḷhavinayassa paṭiññātakaraṇassa tassapāpiyasikāya tiṇavatthārakassa yebhuyyasikāya aññabhāgiyo.

The settlement by mindfulness belongs to the same group as the settlement in the presence; it belongs to a different group from the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, the settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, the settlement of covering with grass, and the settlement by majority.

Amūḷhavinayo sammukhāvinayassa tabbhāgiyo, paṭiññātakaraṇassa tassapāpiyasikāya tiṇavatthārakassa yebhuyyasikāya sativinayassa aññabhāgiyo.

The settlement for one who has recovered from insanity belongs to the same group as the settlement in the presence; it belongs to a different group from the settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, the settlement of covering with grass, the settlement by majority, and the settlement by mindfulness.

Paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ sammukhāvinayassa tabbhāgiyaṃ, tassapāpiyasikāya tiṇavatthārakassa yebhuyyasikāya sativinayassa amūḷhavinayassa aññabhāgiyaṃ.

The settlement by acknowledgment belongs to the same group as the settlement in the presence; it belongs to a different group from the settlement for a specific depravity, the settlement of covering with grass, the settlement by majority, the settlement by mindfulness, and the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity.

Tassapāpiyasikā sammukhāvinayassa tabbhāgiyā, tiṇavatthārakassa yebhuyyasikāya sativinayassa amūḷhavinayassa paṭiññātakaraṇassa aññabhāgiyā.

The settlement for a specific depravity belongs to the same group as the settlement in the presence; it belongs to a different group from the settlement of covering with grass, the settlement by majority, the settlement by mindfulness, the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, and the settlement by acknowledgment.

Tiṇavatthārako sammukhāvinayassa tabbhāgiyo, yebhuyyasikāya sativinayassa amūḷhavinayassa paṭiññātakaraṇassa tassapāpiyasikāya aññabhāgiyo. Evaṃ siyā samathā samathassa tabbhāgiyā, evaṃ siyā [T 0.0267] samathā samathassa aññabhāgiyā.

The settlement of covering with grass belongs to the same group as the settlement in the presence; it belongs to a different group from the settlement by majority, the settlement by mindfulness, the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, the settlement by acknowledgment, and the settlement for a specific depravity. Thus, some settlements belong to the same group as a settlement; thus, some settlements belong to a different group from a settlement.

Samathā samathassa tabbhāgiyavāro niṭṭhito dasamo.

The tenth section, on settlements belonging to the same group as a settlement, is concluded.

11. Samathasammukhāvinayavāro

11. 11. The Section on Settlement and the Settlement in the Presence

301. Samatho [M 0.0189][V 0.0211] sammukhāvinayo, sammukhāvinayo samatho? Samatho yebhuyyasikā, yebhuyyasikā samatho? Samatho sativinayo[P 5.0105], sativinayo samatho? Samatho amūḷhavinayo, amūḷhavinayo samatho? Samatho paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ samatho? Samatho tassapāpiyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā samatho? Samatho tiṇavatthārako, tiṇavatthārako samatho?

301. Is a settlement the settlement in the presence? Is the settlement in the presence a settlement? Is a settlement the settlement by majority? Is the settlement by majority a settlement? Is a settlement the settlement by mindfulness? Is the settlement by mindfulness a settlement? Is a settlement the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity? Is the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity a settlement? Is a settlement the settlement by acknowledgment? Is the settlement by acknowledgment a settlement? Is a settlement the settlement for a specific depravity? Is the settlement for a specific depravity a settlement? Is a settlement the settlement of covering with grass? Is the settlement of covering with grass a settlement?

Yebhuyyasikā sativinayo amūḷhavinayo paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ tassapāpiyasikā tiṇavatthārako – ime samathā samathā, no sammukhāvinayo. Sammukhāvinayo samatho ceva sammukhāvinayo ca.

The settlement by majority, the settlement by mindfulness, the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, the settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, and the settlement of covering with grass—these settlements are settlements, but not the settlement in the presence. The settlement in the presence is both a settlement and the settlement in the presence.

Sativinayo amūḷhavinayo paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ tassapāpiyasikā tiṇavatthārako sammukhāvinayo – ime samathā samathā, no yebhuyyasikā. Yebhuyyasikā samatho ceva yebhuyyasikā ca.

The settlement by mindfulness, the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, the settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, the settlement of covering with grass, and the settlement in the presence—these settlements are settlements, but not the settlement by majority. The settlement by majority is both a settlement and the settlement by majority.

Amūḷhavinayo paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ tassapāpiyasikā tiṇavatthārako sammukhāvinayo yebhuyyasikā – ime samathā samathā, no sativinayo. Sativinayo samatho ceva sativinayo ca.

The settlement for one who has recovered from insanity, the settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, the settlement of covering with grass, the settlement in the presence, and the settlement by majority—these settlements are settlements, but not the settlement by mindfulness. The settlement by mindfulness is both a settlement and the settlement by mindfulness.

Paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ tassapāpiyasikā tiṇavatthārako sammukhāvinayo yebhuyyasikā sativinayo – ime samathā samathā, no amūḷhavinayo. Amūḷhavinayo samatho ceva amūḷhavinayo ca.

The settlement by acknowledgment, the settlement for a specific depravity, the settlement of covering with grass, the settlement in the presence, the settlement by majority, and the settlement by mindfulness—these settlements are settlements, but not the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity. The settlement for one who has recovered from insanity is both a settlement and the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity.

Tassapāpiyasikā tiṇavatthārako sammukhāvinayo yebhuyyasikā sativinayo amūḷhavinayo – ime samathā samathā, no paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ. Paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ [T 0.0268] samatho ceva paṭiññātakaraṇañca.

The settlement for a specific depravity, the settlement of covering with grass, the settlement in the presence, the settlement by majority, the settlement by mindfulness, and the settlement for one who has recovered from insanity—these settlements are settlements, but not the settlement by acknowledgment. The settlement by acknowledgment is both a settlement and the settlement by acknowledgment.

Tiṇavatthārako sammukhāvinayo yebhuyyasikā sativinayo amūḷhavinayo paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ – ime samathā samathā, no tassapāpiyasikā. Tassapāpiyasikā samatho ceva tassapāpiyasikā ca.

Settlement by covering with grass, settlement in the presence, settlement by majority, settlement by mindfulness, settlement for one who is not deluded, settlement by acknowledgement—these are settlements, but not the procedure for one's bad character. The procedure for one's bad character is both a settlement and the procedure for one's bad character.

Sammukhāvinayo [V 0.0212] yebhuyyasikā sativinayo amūḷhavinayo paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ tassapāpiyasikā – ime samathā samathā, no tiṇavatthārako. Tiṇavatthārako samatho ceva tiṇavatthārako ca.

Settlement in the presence, settlement by majority, settlement by mindfulness, settlement for one who is not deluded, settlement by acknowledgement, the procedure for one's bad character—these are settlements, but not settlement by covering with grass. Settlement by covering with grass is both a settlement and settlement by covering with grass.

Samathasammukhāvinayavāro niṭṭhito ekādasamo.

The Eleventh Chapter on Settlement and Settlement in the Presence is concluded.

12. Vinayavāro

12. The Chapter on Discipline

302. Vinayo [M 0.0190] sammukhāvinayo, sammukhāvinayo vinayo? Vinayo yebhuyyasikā, yebhuyyasikā vinayo? Vinayo sativinayo, sativinayo vinayo? Vinayo amūḷhavinayo, amūḷhavinayo vinayo? Vinayo paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ vinayo? Vinayo tassapāpiyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā vinayo? Vinayo tiṇavatthārako, tiṇavatthārako vinayo?

302. Is Discipline settlement in the presence? Is settlement in the presence Discipline? Is Discipline settlement by majority? Is settlement by majority Discipline? Is Discipline settlement by mindfulness? Is settlement by mindfulness Discipline? Is Discipline settlement for one who is not deluded? Is settlement for one who is not deluded Discipline? Is Discipline settlement by acknowledgement? Is settlement by acknowledgement Discipline? Is Discipline the procedure for one's bad character? Is the procedure for one's bad character Discipline? Is Discipline settlement by covering with grass? Is settlement by covering with grass Discipline?

Vinayo siyā sammukhāvinayo siyā na sammukhāvinayo. Sammukhāvinayo vinayo ceva sammukhāvinayo ca.

Discipline might be a settlement in the presence, or it might not be a settlement in the presence. A settlement in the presence is both Discipline and a settlement in the presence.

Vinayo siyā yebhuyyasikā, siyā na yebhuyyasikā. Yebhuyyasikā vinayo ceva yebhuyyasikā ca.

Discipline might be a settlement by majority, or it might not be a settlement by majority. A settlement by majority is both Discipline and a settlement by majority.

Vinayo siyā sativinayo, siyā na sativinayo. Sativinayo vinayo ceva sativinayo ca.

Discipline might be a settlement by mindfulness, or it might not be a settlement by mindfulness. A settlement by mindfulness is both Discipline and a settlement by mindfulness.

Vinayo siyā amūḷhavinayo, siyā na amūḷhavinayo. Amūḷhavinayo vinayo ceva amūḷhavinayo ca[T 0.0269].

Discipline might be a settlement for one who is not deluded, or it might not be a settlement for one who is not deluded. A settlement for one who is not deluded is both Discipline and a settlement for one who is not deluded.

Vinayo siyā paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, siyā na paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ. Paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ vinayo ceva paṭiññātakaraṇañca.

Discipline may be a settlement by acknowledgement, or it may not be a settlement by acknowledgement. A settlement by acknowledgement is both Discipline and a settlement by acknowledgement.

Vinayo [V 0.0213] siyā tassapāpiyasikā, siyā na tassapāpiyasikā. Tassapāpiyasikā vinayo ceva tassapāpiyasikā ca.

Discipline may be the procedure for one's bad character, or it may not be the procedure for one's bad character. The procedure for one's bad character is both Discipline and the procedure for one's bad character.

Vinayo siyā tiṇavatthārako, siyā na tiṇavatthārako. Tiṇavatthārako vinayo ceva tiṇavatthārako ca.

Discipline may be a settlement by covering with grass, or it may not be a settlement by covering with grass. A settlement by covering with grass is both Discipline and a settlement by covering with grass.

Vinayavāro niṭṭhito dvādasamo.

The twelfth chapter on Discipline is concluded.

13. Kusalavāro

13. The Chapter on the Wholesome

303. Sammukhāvinayo kusalo akusalo abyākato? Yebhuyyasikā kusalā akusalā abyākatā? Sativinayo kusalo akusalo abyākato? Amūḷhavinayo kusalo akusalo [M 0.0191] abyākato? Paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ kusalaṃ akusalaṃ abyākataṃ? Tassapāpiyasikā kusalā akusalā abyākatā? Tiṇavatthārako kusalo akusalo abyākato?

303. Is settlement in the presence wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate? Is settlement by majority wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate? Is settlement by mindfulness wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate? Is settlement for one who is not deluded wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate? Is settlement by acknowledgement wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate? Is the procedure for one's bad character wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate? Is settlement by covering with grass wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate?

Sammukhāvinayo siyā kusalo, siyā abyākato. Natthi sammukhāvinayo akusalo.

A settlement in the presence may be wholesome, or it may be indeterminate. There is no settlement in the presence that is unwholesome.

Yebhuyyasikā siyā kusalā, siyā akusalā, siyā abyākatā.

Settlement by majority may be wholesome, may be unwholesome, or may be indeterminate.

Sativinayo siyā kusalo, siyā akusalo, siyā abyākato.

A settlement by mindfulness may be wholesome, may be unwholesome, or may be indeterminate.

Amūḷhavinayo siyā kusalo, siyā akusalo, siyā abyākato.

A settlement for one who is not deluded may be wholesome, may be unwholesome, or may be indeterminate.

Paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ siyā kusalaṃ, siyā akusalaṃ, siyā abyākataṃ.

A settlement by acknowledgement may be wholesome, may be unwholesome, or may be indeterminate.

Tassapāpiyasikā siyā kusalā, siyā akusalā siyā abyākatā.

The procedure for one's bad character may be wholesome, may be unwholesome, or may be indeterminate.

Tiṇavatthārako siyā kusalo, siyā akusalo, siyā abyākato.

Settlement by covering with grass may be wholesome, may be unwholesome, or may be indeterminate.

Vivādādhikaraṇaṃ kusalaṃ akusalaṃ abyākataṃ. Anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ kusalaṃ akusalaṃ [V 0.0214] abyākataṃ. Āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kusalaṃ akusalaṃ abyākataṃ. Kiccādhikaraṇaṃ [T 0.0270] kusalaṃ akusalaṃ abyākataṃ.

Is a legal issue concerning disputes wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate? Is a legal issue concerning accusations wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate? Is a legal issue concerning offenses wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate? Is a legal issue concerning duties wholesome, unwholesome, or indeterminate?

Vivādādhikaraṇaṃ [P 5.0106] siyā kusalaṃ, siyā akusalaṃ, siyā abyākataṃ.

A legal issue concerning disputes may be wholesome, may be unwholesome, or may be indeterminate.

Anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ siyā kusalaṃ, siyā akusalaṃ, siyā abyākataṃ.

A legal issue concerning accusations may be wholesome, may be unwholesome, or may be indeterminate.

Āpattādhikaraṇaṃ siyā akusalaṃ, siyā abyākataṃ. Natthi āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kusalaṃ.

A legal issue concerning offenses may be unwholesome, or it may be indeterminate. There is no legal issue concerning offenses that is wholesome.

Kiccādhikaraṇaṃ siyā kusalaṃ, siyā akusalaṃ, siyā abyākataṃ.

A legal issue concerning duties may be wholesome, may be unwholesome, or may be indeterminate.

Kusalavāro niṭṭhito terasamo.

The thirteenth chapter on the Wholesome is concluded.

14. Yatthavāro, pucchāvāro

14. The Section on Where, the Section on Questions

304. Yattha [M 0.0192] yebhuyyasikā labbhati, tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati; yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati. Na tattha sativinayo labbhati, na tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati, na tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati.

304. Where settlement by majority is obtained, there settlement in the presence is obtained; where settlement in the presence is obtained, there settlement by majority is obtained. There settlement by mindfulness is not obtained, there settlement for one who is not deluded is not obtained, there settlement by acknowledgement is not obtained, there the procedure for one's bad character is not obtained, there settlement by covering with grass is not obtained.

Yattha sativinayo labbhati, tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati; yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, tattha sativinayo labbhati. Na tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati, na tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati, na tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati.

Where settlement by mindfulness is obtained, there settlement in the presence is obtained; where settlement in the presence is obtained, there settlement by mindfulness is obtained. There settlement for one who is not deluded is not obtained, there settlement by acknowledgement is not obtained, there the procedure for one's bad character is not obtained, there settlement by covering with grass is not obtained, there settlement by majority is not obtained.

Yattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati, tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati; yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati. Na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati, na tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati, na tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati, na tattha sativinayo labbhati.

Where settlement for one who is not deluded is obtained, there settlement in the presence is obtained; where settlement in the presence is obtained, there settlement for one who is not deluded is obtained. There settlement by acknowledgement is not obtained, there the procedure for one's bad character is not obtained, there settlement by covering with grass is not obtained, there settlement by majority is not obtained, there settlement by mindfulness is not obtained.

Yattha [V 0.0215] paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati, tattha sammukhāvinayo [T 0.0271] labbhati; yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati. Na tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati, na tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati, na tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati, na tattha sativinayo labbhati, na tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati.

Where settlement by acknowledgement is obtained, there settlement in the presence is obtained; where settlement in the presence is obtained, there settlement by acknowledgement is obtained. There the procedure for one's bad character is not obtained, there settlement by covering with grass is not obtained, there settlement by majority is not obtained, there settlement by mindfulness is not obtained, there settlement for one who is not deluded is not obtained.

Yattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati, tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati; yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati. Na tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati, na tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati, na tattha sativinayo labbhati, na tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati.

Where the procedure for one of worse character is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there the procedure for one of worse character is applicable. There, the covering over with grass is not applicable, the decision by majority is not applicable, the verdict of innocence is not applicable, the verdict of past insanity is not applicable, and acting on an admission is not applicable.

Yattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati, tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati; yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati. Na tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati, na tattha sativinayo labbhati, na tattha amūḷhavinayo [M 0.0193] labbhati, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati.

Where the covering over with grass is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there the covering over with grass is applicable. There, the decision by majority is not applicable, the verdict of innocence is not applicable, the verdict of past insanity is not applicable, acting on an admission is not applicable, and the procedure for one of worse character is not applicable.

Yattha yebhuyyasikā tattha sammukhāvinayo; yattha sammukhāvinayo tattha yebhuyyasikā. Na tattha sativinayo, na tattha amūḷhavinayo, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā, na tattha tiṇavatthārako.

Where the decision by majority is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there the decision by majority is applicable. There, the verdict of innocence is not applicable, the verdict of past insanity is not applicable, acting on an admission is not applicable, the procedure for one of worse character is not applicable, and the covering over with grass is not applicable.

Yattha sativinayo tattha sammukhāvinayo; yattha sammukhāvinayo tattha sativinayo. Na tattha amūḷhavinayo, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā, na tattha tiṇavatthārako, na tattha yebhuyyasikā. Sammukhāvinayaṃ [T 0.0272] kātuna mūlaṃ…pe….

Where the verdict of innocence is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there the verdict of innocence is applicable. There, the verdict of past insanity is not applicable, acting on an admission is not applicable, the procedure for one of worse character is not applicable, the covering over with grass is not applicable, and the decision by majority is not applicable. Having carried out the procedure in the presence, the root... etc.

Yattha tiṇavatthārako tattha sammukhāvinayo; yattha sammukhāvinayo tattha tiṇavatthārako. Na tattha yebhuyyasikā, na tattha sativinayo, na tattha amūḷhavinayo, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā.

Where the covering over with grass is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there the covering over with grass is applicable. There, the decision by majority is not applicable, the verdict of innocence is not applicable, the verdict of past insanity is not applicable, acting on an admission is not applicable, and the procedure for one of worse character is not applicable.

Cakkapeyyālaṃ.

The Wheel Repetition.

Yatthavāro niṭṭhito cuddasamo.

The fourteenth Section on 'Where' is concluded.

15. Samathavāro, vissajjanāvāro

15. 15. The Section on Settlement, the Section on Resolution

305. Yasmiṃ [V 0.0216] samaye sammukhāvinayena ca yebhuyyasikāya ca adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati, yattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati. Na tattha sativinayo labbhati, na tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati, na tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati.

305. At a time when a legal issue is settled by the procedure in the presence and by the decision by majority, where the decision by majority is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there the decision by majority is applicable. There, the verdict of innocence is not applicable, the verdict of past insanity is not applicable, acting on an admission is not applicable, the procedure for one of worse character is not applicable, and the covering over with grass is not applicable.

Yasmiṃ [P 5.0107] samaye sammukhāvinayena ca sativinayena ca adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati, yattha sativinayo labbhati tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati tattha sativinayo labbhati. Na tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā [M 0.0194] labbhati, na tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati, na tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati.

At a time when a legal issue is settled by the procedure in the presence and by the verdict of innocence, where the verdict of innocence is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there the verdict of innocence is applicable. There, the verdict of past insanity is not applicable, acting on an admission is not applicable, the procedure for one of worse character is not applicable, the covering over with grass is not applicable, and the decision by majority is not applicable.

Yasmiṃ samaye sammukhāvinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati, yattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati. Na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati, na tattha [T 0.0273] tiṇavatthārako labbhati, na tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati, na tattha sativinayo labbhati.

At a time when a legal issue is settled by the procedure in the presence and by the verdict of past insanity, where the verdict of past insanity is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there the verdict of past insanity is applicable. There, acting on an admission is not applicable, the procedure for one of worse character is not applicable, the covering over with grass is not applicable, the decision by majority is not applicable, and the verdict of innocence is not applicable.

Yasmiṃ samaye sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati, yattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati. Na tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati, na tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati, na tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati, na tattha sativinayo labbhati, na tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati.

At a time when a legal issue is settled by the procedure in the presence and by acting on an admission, where acting on an admission is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there acting on an admission is applicable. There, the procedure for one of worse character is not applicable, the covering over with grass is not applicable, the decision by majority is not applicable, the verdict of innocence is not applicable, and the verdict of past insanity is not applicable.

Yasmiṃ samaye sammukhāvinayena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati, yattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati. Na tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati, na tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati, na [V 0.0217] tattha sativinayo labbhati, na tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati.

At a time when a legal issue is settled by the procedure in the presence and by the procedure for one of worse character, where the procedure for one of worse character is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there the procedure for one of worse character is applicable. There, the covering over with grass is not applicable, the decision by majority is not applicable, the verdict of innocence is not applicable, the verdict of past insanity is not applicable, and acting on an admission is not applicable.

Yasmiṃ samaye sammukhāvinayena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati, yattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati tattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati, yattha sammukhāvinayo labbhati tattha tiṇavatthārako labbhati. Na tattha yebhuyyasikā labbhati, na tattha sativinayo labbhati, na tattha amūḷhavinayo labbhati, na tattha paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ labbhati, na tattha tassapāpiyasikā labbhati.

At a time when a legal issue is settled by the procedure in the presence and by the covering over with grass, where the covering over with grass is applicable, there the procedure in the presence is applicable; where the procedure in the presence is applicable, there the covering over with grass is applicable. There, the decision by majority is not applicable, the verdict of innocence is not applicable, the verdict of past insanity is not applicable, acting on an admission is not applicable, and the procedure for one of worse character is not applicable.

Samathavāro niṭṭhito pannarasamo.

The Fifteenth Section on Settlements is concluded.

16. Saṃsaṭṭhavāro

16. 16. The Section on Combination

306. Adhikaraṇanti [T 0.0274][M 0.0195] vā samathāti vā ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā udāhu visaṃsaṭṭhā? Labbhā ca panimesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujjitvā vinibbhujjitvā (ka.), ṭīkāyaṃ ekapadameva dissati nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetunti?

306. Are these phenomena, namely, legal issues and settlements, conjoined or, on the other hand, disjoined? And is it possible, having analyzed them again and again, to declare a distinction between these phenomena?

Adhikaraṇanti vā samathāti vā ime dhammā visaṃsaṭṭhā, no saṃsaṭṭhā. Labbhā ca panimesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetunti. So – “mā heva”ntissa vacanīyo. Adhikaraṇanti vā samathāti vā ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā, no visaṃsaṭṭhā. No ca labbhā na ca labbhā (ka.) imesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ. Taṃ kissa hetu? Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “cattārimāni, bhikkhave, adhikaraṇāni, satta samathā. Adhikaraṇā samathehi sammanti, samathā adhikaraṇehi sammanti. Evaṃ, ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā no visaṃsaṭṭhā; no ca labbhā imesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetu”nti.

If one were to say, ‘“Legal issues” or “settlements”—these states are unassociated, not associated. It is possible, having separated and separated these states, to declare a distinction,’ he should be told, ‘Do not say so.’ ‘Legal issues’ or ‘settlements’—these states are associated, not unassociated. It is not possible, having separated and separated these states, to declare a distinction. For what reason? Was it not said by the Blessed One: ‘Bhikkhus, there are these four legal issues and seven settlements. Legal issues are settled by settlements, and settlements are settled by legal issues’? Thus, these states are associated, not unassociated; and it is not possible, having separated and separated these states, to declare a distinction.

Saṃsaṭṭhavāro niṭṭhito soḷasamo.

The Section on Association, the sixteenth, is finished.

17. Sammativāro

17. 17. The Section on Settling

307. Vivādādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati? Anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati? Āpattādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati? Kiccādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati?

307. By how many settlements is a legal issue of dispute settled? By how many settlements is a legal issue of accusation settled? By how many settlements is a legal issue of offense settled? By how many settlements is a legal issue of duties settled?

cūḷava. 228, 236 ādayo Vivādādhikaraṇaṃ [V 0.0218] dvīhi samathehi sammati – sammukhāvinayena ca yebhuyyasikāya ca.

A legal issue of dispute is settled by two settlements: by adjudication in the presence of and by the procedure of majority decision.

cūḷava. 228, 236 ādayo Anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ catūhi samathehi sammati – sammukhāvinayena ca sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca.

A legal issue of accusation is settled by four settlements: by adjudication in the presence of, by adjudication by mindfulness, by adjudication for one formerly insane, and by the procedure for one who deserves further punishment.

cūḷava. 239, 242 ādayo Āpattādhikaraṇaṃ tīhi samathehi [T 0.0275] sammati – sammukhāvinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

A legal issue of offense is settled by three settlements: by adjudication in the presence of, by acting on an acknowledgement, and by the procedure of covering over with grass.

cūḷava. 239, 242 ādayo Kiccādhikaraṇaṃ ekena samathena sammati – sammukhāvinayena.

A legal issue of duties is settled by one settlement: by adjudication in the presence of.

Vivādādhikaraṇañca [M 0.0196] anuvādādhikaraṇañca katihi samathehi sammanti? Vivādādhikaraṇañca anuvādādhikaraṇañca pañcahi samathehi sammanti – sammukhāvinayena ca yebhuyyasikāya ca sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca.

By how many settlements are a legal issue of dispute and a legal issue of accusation settled? A legal issue of dispute and a legal issue of accusation are settled by five settlements: by adjudication in the presence of, by the procedure of majority decision, by adjudication by mindfulness, by adjudication for one formerly insane, and by the procedure for one who deserves further punishment.

Vivādādhikaraṇañca [P 5.0108] āpattādhikaraṇañca katihi samathehi sammanti? Vivādādhikaraṇañca āpattādhikaraṇañca catūhi samathehi sammanti – sammukhāvinayena ca yebhuyyasikāya ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

By how many settlements are a legal issue of dispute and a legal issue of offense settled? A legal issue of dispute and a legal issue of offense are settled by four settlements: by adjudication in the presence of, by the procedure of majority decision, by acting on an acknowledgement, and by the procedure of covering over with grass.

Vivādādhikaraṇañca kiccādhikaraṇañca katihi samathehi sammanti? Vivādādhikaraṇañca kiccādhikaraṇañca dvīhi samathehi sammanti – sammukhāvinayena ca yebhuyyasikāya ca.

By how many settlements are a legal issue of dispute and a legal issue of duties settled? A legal issue of dispute and a legal issue of duties are settled by two settlements: by adjudication in the presence of and by the procedure of majority decision.

Anuvādādhikaraṇañca āpattādhikaraṇañca katihi samathehi sammanti? Anuvādādhikaraṇañca āpattādhikaraṇañca chahi samathehi sammanti – sammukhāvinayena ca sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

By how many settlements are a legal issue of accusation and a legal issue of offense settled? A legal issue of accusation and a legal issue of offense are settled by six settlements: by adjudication in the presence of, by adjudication by mindfulness, by adjudication for one formerly insane, by acting on an acknowledgement, by the procedure for one who deserves further punishment, and by the procedure of covering over with grass.

Anuvādādhikaraṇañca kiccādhikaraṇañca katihi samathehi sammanti? Anuvādādhikaraṇañca kiccādhikaraṇañca catūhi samathehi sammanti – sammukhāvinayena ca sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca.

By how many settlements are a legal issue of accusation and a legal issue of duties settled? A legal issue of accusation and a legal issue of duties are settled by four settlements: by adjudication in the presence of, by adjudication by mindfulness, by adjudication for one formerly insane, and by the procedure for one who deserves further punishment.

By how many settlements are a legal issue of offense and a legal issue of duties settled? A legal issue of offense and a legal issue of duties are settled by three settlements: by adjudication in the presence of, by acting on an acknowledgement, and by the procedure of covering over with grass.

A legal issue of dispute, a legal issue of accusation, and a legal issue of offense are settled by seven settlements: by adjudication in the presence of, by the procedure of majority decision, by adjudication by mindfulness, by adjudication for one formerly insane, by acting on an acknowledgement, by the procedure for one who deserves further punishment, and by the procedure of covering over with grass.

A legal issue of accusation, a legal issue of offense, and a legal issue of duties are settled by six settlements: by adjudication in the presence of, by adjudication by mindfulness, by adjudication for one formerly insane, by acting on an acknowledgement, by the procedure for one who deserves further punishment, and by the procedure of covering over with grass.

Vivādādhikaraṇañca anuvādādhikaraṇañca āpattādhikaraṇañca kiccādhikaraṇañca sattahi samathehi sammanti – sammukhāvinayena ca yebhuyyasikāya ca sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

Sammativāro niṭṭhito sattarasamo.

The Section on Settling, the seventeenth, is finished.

18. Sammanti na sammantivāro

18. 18. The Section on Settling and Not Settling

308. Vivādādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati, katihi samathehi na sammati? Anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati, katihi samathehi na sammati? Āpattādhikaraṇaṃ katihi [V 0.0220] samathehi sammati, katihi samathehi na sammati? Kiccādhikaraṇaṃ katihi samathehi sammati, katihi samathehi na sammati?

308. By how many settlements is a legal issue of dispute settled, and by how many is it not settled? By how many settlements is a legal issue of accusation settled, and by how many is it not settled? By how many settlements is a legal issue of offense settled, and by how many is it not settled? By how many settlements is a legal issue of duties settled, and by how many is it not settled?

Vivādādhikaraṇaṃ dvīhi samathehi sammati – sammukhāvinayena ca yebhuyyasikāya [T 0.0277] ca. Pañcahi samathehi na sammati – sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

A legal issue of dispute is settled by two settlements: by settlement in the presence and by settlement by majority. It is not settled by five settlements: by settlement by mindfulness, by settlement for one who is no longer insane, by settlement by acknowledgment, by settlement for one of bad character, and by settlement of covering over with grass.

Anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ catūhi samathehi sammati – sammukhāvinayena ca sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca. Tīhi samathehi na sammati – yebhuyyasikāya ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

A legal issue of accusation is settled by four settlements: by settlement in the presence, by settlement by mindfulness, by settlement for one who is no longer insane, and by settlement for one of bad character. It is not settled by three settlements: by settlement by majority, by settlement by acknowledgment, and by settlement of covering over with grass.

A legal issue of an offense is settled by three settlements: by settlement in the presence, by settlement by acknowledgment, and by settlement of covering over with grass. It is not settled by four settlements: by settlement by majority, by settlement by mindfulness, by settlement for one who is no longer insane, and by settlement for one of bad character.

Kiccādhikaraṇaṃ [P 5.0109] ekena samathena sammati – sammukhāvinayena. Chahi samathehi na sammati – yebhuyyasikāya ca sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca paṭiññātakaraṇena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

A legal issue of duties is settled by one settlement: by settlement in the presence. It is not settled by six settlements: by settlement by majority, by settlement by mindfulness, by settlement for one who is no longer insane, by settlement by acknowledgment, by settlement for one of bad character, and by settlement of covering over with grass.

Vivādādhikaraṇañca anuvādādhikaraṇañca katihi samathehi sammanti? Katihi samathehi na sammanti? Vivādādhikaraṇañca anuvādādhikaraṇañca pañcahi samathehi sammanti – sammukhāvinayena ca yebhuyyasikāya ca sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca. Dvīhi samathehi na sammanti – paṭiññātakaraṇena ca tiṇavatthārakena ca.

By how many settlements are legal issues of dispute and legal issues of accusation settled? By how many settlements are they not settled? Legal issues of dispute and legal issues of accusation are settled by five settlements: by settlement in the presence, by settlement by majority, by settlement by mindfulness, by settlement for one who is no longer insane, and by settlement for one of bad character. They are not settled by two settlements: by settlement by acknowledgment and by settlement of covering over with grass.

Tīhi samathehi na sammanti – sativinayena ca amūḷhavinayena ca tassapāpiyasikāya ca.
